raw.excerpt: Who We Are Mercy Ships is a global faith-based charity that uses hospital ships to bring life-changing surgeries and transformational medical training to people in some of the most challenging contexts along the African coast.
raw.description:
Who We Are Mercy Ships is a global faith-based charity that uses hospital ships to bring life-changing surgeries and transformational medical training to people in some of the most challenging contexts along the African coast. For over 40 years, Mercy Ships has been delivering lasting hope and healing through safe surgical care, while working alongside partners and stakeholders to strengthen local healthcare systems in more than 55 countries. Since the inception of this dream by founders Don and Deyon Stephens in 1978, Mercy Ships has served more than 2.7 million direct beneficiaries without regard for race, gender, or religion. Do you have a heart for the hurting and a desire to invest your talents and experiences into a mission with eternal significance? For every transformative surgery that takes place onboard one of our Mercy Ships, there are dozens of men and women being used of the Lord to prepare the way through their vocational gifts and talents!

This is a full-time remote role that requires international travel.

  • Annual Compensation Range is $90,000-$96,900
  • Compensation range listed is for U.S. hires only. Actual compensation may vary dependent upon location of hire.

As a Technical Superintendent you will manage the preparations required to take delivery of the Africa Mercy II and bring it into operations to sail and begin her field service operations

This includes creating operational documentation, maintenance plans, parts and supplies for the ship to enter service upon delivery. Once delivered transition into the role of Technical Superintendent. Prepare and submit any necessary Warranty Claims

How You'll Contribute:

  • Develop and coordinate SMS documentation, regulatory documentation and shipboard manuals.
  • Oversee and support the building of the planned maintenance system and upon delivery monitor routine and corrective maintenance onboard assigned vessel
  • In conjunction with Director of New Building ensure all necessary classification and Flag State requirements are in place to ensure timely Delivery then monitor such documents to ensure completion of scheduled surveys and/or attention to identified defects
  • Oversee preparation of work plans for technical areas for equipping phase and initial field service, while planning for annual maintenance phases, including drydocking when required.
  • Review requests for repairs and/or modifications to determine compliance with statutory regulations and classification society rules.
  • As necessary, inspect machinery, equipment, or spaces outlined in work and modification requests; draw up job specifications; and obtain bids from contractors or shipyards to perform repairs. (Both Warranty and non-warranty work)
  • Maintain contact with contractors to ensure completion of work according to contract terms.
  • Investigate machinery casualties to determine cause; advise ships officers in methods of operation to prevent recurrence of casualty or malfunction.
  • Plan supply stocks for all marine operations specialties to ensure engineers, plumbing, electrical, hotel engineer, and deck have the repair parts and consumables on hand to sustain the safe operation of the ship.
  • Maintain records of technical expenses for each ship such as repairs, supplies, and personnel.
  • Liaise with regulatory agencies to ensure that requirements for alterations, repairs, or modifications are kept at minimum cost consistent with safety.
  • Review and advise on qualifications of technical staff and/or applicants as requested.
  • Maintain proficient knowledge of Company SMS; assist QHSE Manager to ensure safe working practices are followed onboard.
  • Visit the from time to time during construction and equipping (final fit out) as well as after the vessel is operational and in field service. Conduct the annual Company Vessel Inspection after Delivery
  • Other duties as assigned.

Ideal Candidate:

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, contractors, suppliers, and the general public
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
  • Ability to travel nationally and internationally.
  • Preference is to work from Mercy Ships International Support Center in Lindale, Texas – remote work may be considered
  • Certificate of Competency in accordance with STCW III/2 required; Chief Engineer preferred.
  • Supportive of Mercy Ships mission and vision and committed to its core values.
  • Understand and apply servant leadership, work collaboratively with integrity and demonstrate accountability.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree (B.Sc.) from four-year College or University; with 10 years related industry experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Two or more years of service aboard ROPAX or Cruise vessels to provide the necessary background in sustaining a vessel with a substantial crew aboard.
  • Successful completion of Mercy Ships Entry Training will be required within the first year.

Pour your God-given talents into a mission with eternal return on investment -- join the Mercy Ships Crew, today! This is a paid position. To explore our many Mercy Ships volunteer opportunities, please visit us at:

As an integral part of our leadership team, you will be responsible for crafting and implementing fundraising strategies that support our mission to provide news on life, faith, family, and culture. This role is pivotal in ensuring we have the necessary resources to grow and sustain our mission.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive fundraising strategy, including but not limited to quarterly giving campaigns, major gifts, and grants.
  • Cultivate and nurture relationships with new and existing donors, including individuals, and foundations.
  • Lead and expand our development team, fostering an environment of growth, efficiency, and innovation.
  • Oversee the management of all fundraising campaigns, ensuring they meet strategic goals and budget forecasts.
  • Collaborate with the marketing and editorial department to enhance fundraising messages and donor engagement strategies.
  • Monitor and report regularly on the progress of the development program to the executive team.
  • Stay informed of trends, legislation, and best practices in fundraising and nonprofit management to adapt strategies as necessary.

  • Deep commitment to the mission and values of LifeSite News.

Please submit your resume, detailed cover letter explaining why you want to work for LifeSiteNews, and three professional references. The position will remain open until filled, and we encourage early applications.

About Crosswalk Health

Crosswalk Health partners with physician practices nationwide to deliver pulmonary diagnostic services through our

respiratory therapists. As we grow, we need a resourceful recruiter who can find and engage great clinical talent - not

simply monitor applications.

The Role

Own recruiting for respiratory therapists and other clinical roles. Build relationships and candidate pipelines proactively,

move quickly as priorities change, and keep candidates and leadership consistently informed. Quality hires and retention

matter more than hours logged. In this role, success looks like: strong candidate pipelines before openings become urgent, fast and thoughtful hiring, excellent communication, high-quality hires who stay, and continual improvement of the recruiting process.

What you'll do

  • Proactively source candidates through networking, referrals, social media, professional groups, job boards, and other creative channels.
  • Build qualified pipelines ahead of market launches and adjust sourcing strategies when a role is difficult to fill.
  • Screen candidates, coordinate interviews, and maintain responsive communication throughout the hiring process.
  • Guide candidates through offers, onboarding, and pre-employment requirements.
  • Partner with leadership on staffing needs and keep priorities, progress, and roadblocks highly visible.
  • Maintain organized records and track pipeline, time-to-fill, hires, and retention.
  • Improve recruiting processes and, over time, take on additional HR responsibilities based on business needs and
  • experience.

Qualifications

  • Prior recruiting or talent acquisition experience; healthcare recruiting is strongly preferred.
  • A proactive networker and creative sourcer who enjoys finding candidates rather than waiting for applications.
  • Highly organized, efficient, responsive, and comfortable taking initiative.
  • Excellent follow-through and a willingness to over-communicate in a fast-changing remote environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple openings and priorities while maintaining a strong candidate experience.
  • Experience with recruiting tools such as Rippling, Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, or similar platforms.
  • Preferred: Experience recruiting respiratory therapists, nurses, or allied health professionals; knowledge of multi-state hiring or healthcare credentialing; and interest in broader HR work.

Compensation

Expected commitment is no more than 20 hours per week. Compensation rewards efficient recruiting outcomes rather

than hours logged.

  • $750 weekly base compensation.
  • $175 hiring bonus for each candidate who is hired and successfully completes onboarding.
  • $225 retention bonus when that employee reaches 90 days of active employment.

raw.excerpt: About WelocalizeWelocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally.
raw.description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com

Job Summary

In this exciting position, the Spanish Multimedia Content Reviewer will be writing and reviewing linguistic content in Spanish from Spain to ensure the highest quality of accuracy for customers using the world's foremost multimedia platforms. With time the Multimedia Content Reviewer will become the cultural ambassador for the Spanish market and will be expected to produce fully localized content and flag potential cultural issues with content types, wording and articulate suggestions to make all content appropriate and relevant for the target markets. 

The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in Media Marketing with an emphasis on Music Marketing, marketing localization, advertising and localization, combined with proven creative writing skills and exceptional attention to detail.
We are specifically seeking candidates with deep market expertise of Spain, who understand local consumer behavior, marketing trends, cultural nuances, media landscapes, and the music industry ecosystem. Candidates should also demonstrate strong awareness of contemporary music trends, genres, audience preferences, and pop culture relevant to their market.
In addition, candidates should be passionate about media, music entertainment, technology and digital marketing ecosystems.
This will be a 1-year part-time contract with the possibility of being extended after the contract ends.

Main Duties

  • Localize, transcreate and adapt marketing music and media-related content to ensure maximum relevance, engagement and effectiveness for the Spanish audience while maintaining brand voice and messaging objectives.
  • In addition to Music related marketing copy, you may also be asked to write, review and optimize marketing-oriented copy across multimedia products, digital campaigns, promotional materials, apps, audience-facing communications with strong consideration for local market expectations and cultural relevance.
  • Perform regular linguistic review of their own work as well as the work performed by other members of the localization team for all content types.
  • Copy-edit and fact check content to ensure accuracy of content.
  • Perform LQA (Localization QA) testing of any content published on live platforms (music and app descriptions, marketing material and marketing campaigns).
  • Conducts market-specific research on local content treatment, content, product and terminology trends and best localization practices for the Spanish locale and market.
  • Report on data and/or assets across a broad scope of media and content types
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for the Spanish market, providing guidance on marketing language, local consumer preferences, media trends and culturally relevant messaging
  • Collaborate with global language team via virtual meetings, emails on content review tasks to ensure calibrating terminology and style, understanding trends and market specific insights, translations based on the market team's needs. 

Requirements

  • BS/BA and 2+ years of work experience in Media Marketing, Music Marketing, Digital Marketing, Advertising, Marketing Localization, Creative Copywriting or related fields, with proof of writing samples or marketing content contributions
  • Experience in translation and localization of multimedia content
  • Ability to quickly detect issues and inconsistencies from a massive sea of content and make sound judgement calls based on information at hand
  • Possesses deep familiarity with local media channels, marketing trends, digital platforms, entertainment industries and consumer culture within the Spanish market
  • Has ability to own the Spanish language market and make confident linguistic decisions
  • Must be highly detail-oriented with ability to multitask, prioritize and meet deadline
  • Fluency in written and verbal English
  • Native-level fluency in Spanish (from Spain)
  • Strong computer literacy, knowledge of iOS/macOS systems a plus
  • Well capable of typing in their native level language using a local (English) keyboard
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Collaborative; enjoys teamwork in a multicultural environment

Requisition ID

2026-4541

Job Summary

The Change Management Specialist applies knowledge of VA databases, project management tools and techniques, and change management theory and applications supporting the VHA Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) in the stabilization, recovery, and Post Go-Live (PGL) operation of the Oracle Health Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR), with a functional focus on accelerating execution of VHA's organizational change management strategy for EHR adoption.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support execution and acceleration of VHA's organizational change management strategy for EHR adoption.
  • Conduct change-readiness assessments, stakeholder analyses, and impact analyses for workflow and system changes.
  • Develop actionable change deliverables such as communication plans, roadmaps, coaching plans, training plans, and resistance management plans.
  • Apply knowledge of VA databases and their interrelationships to support the ongoing development and enhancement of VA's informatics environment.
  • Apply project management tools and techniques to integrate change management activities into project plans; track and report issues.
  • Support stakeholder engagement and transition support so users understand workflow changes and system updates.
  • Define and measure change-adoption success metrics and monitor change progress.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience.

Desired Qualifications

  • Prosci certification and experience applying change management in a union environment.
  • Experience supporting EHR go-live adoption and PGL stabilization.
  • Knowledge of VA/VHA organizational structure and informatics environment.

Additional Requirements (All Positions)

  • Ability to read, write, speak, and understand the English language.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable VA background investigation at the Low Risk / NACI level, including electronic fingerprinting and e-QIP submission.
  • All work must be performed within the United States; remote work is performed via VA-approved remote access (Citrix Access Gateway) in accordance with VA Handbook 6500 requirements.
  • Availability for occasional CONUS travel to VA Medical Centers (approximately 5-day site visits) in support of EHR Go-Live and Post Go-Live activities, as authorized by the Government.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 applications; working knowledge of SharePoint Online, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI is strongly preferred per the task order Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan.

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Product Manager, Marketing Digital Experience – BAU Portfolio owns the operational framework that enables efficient delivery of marketing-driven work across Lumen.com. This role manages the intake, prioritization, governance, and continuous improvement of the Business as Usual (BAU) value stream, ensuring requests are properly scoped, routed, prioritized, and prepared for execution.
Serving as the connective point between business stakeholders and delivery teams, this position helps translate business needs into actionable work while providing transparency into priorities, capacity, timelines, and outcomes. The role partners closely with Campaigns, Creative, Digital Experience (DX), Marketing Operations (MOps), Product Marketing, Analytics, and Technology teams to maintain an efficient and scalable delivery ecosystem.
As a senior individual contributor, this position drives consistency, operational excellence, and continuous improvement through influence, collaboration, and process leadership rather than direct people management.

Work Location

Fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership

Own the operating model for Lumen's Business as Usual (BAU) digital delivery portfolio.
Lead the end-to-end delivery of marketing campaigns, product launches, website enhancements, and operational requests across Lumen.com.
Develop and maintain prioritization frameworks that balance business value, customer impact, delivery timelines, capacity, and risk.
Align BAU work with broader Digital Experience priorities and roadmaps.
Partner with value stream leaders to optimize planning, resource utilization, and delivery effectiveness.

Intake, Prioritization & Delivery Management

Own the end-to-end intake, triage, and prioritization process, ensuring work is aligned to business objectives, delivery capacity, and strategic priorities.
Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve competing priorities, and provide transparency into delivery plans, timelines, and trade-off decisions.
Establish standards, workflows, and governance practices that improve intake quality, delivery readiness, and execution efficiency.
Drive continuous improvement through analysis of intake trends, stakeholder feedback, and operational performance.

Governance & Operational Excellence

Define, implement, and evolve scalable governance, prioritization, and execution frameworks supporting marketing delivery across Lumen.com.
Establish operational metrics, service expectations, and reporting that provide visibility into demand, throughput, portfolio health, and business outcomes.
Identify bottlenecks and lead process improvement, automation, and workflow modernization initiatives that enhance efficiency, predictability, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Promote adoption of governance standards and best practices across partner organizations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the primary point of coordination among Digital Experience, Campaigns, Creative, Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Analytics, and other stakeholder groups.
Build strong partnerships that enable effective planning, prioritization, execution, and delivery.
Translate business needs into actionable work and facilitate resolution of cross-functional challenges impacting delivery timelines, quality, and business outcomes.
Influence decision-making through data, collaboration, business context, and subject matter expertise while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that measure portfolio health, delivery performance, stakeholder satisfaction, and business impact.
Partner with Analytics and Digital Experience teams to evaluate performance, identify optimization opportunities, and implement process, workflow, and governance enhancements.
Analyze delivery trends, demand, capacity, and operational metrics to improve efficiency, predictability, and stakeholder experience.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Experience

8+ years of experience in digital experience, product management, marketing operations, campaign management, portfolio management, project management, or a related field.
Experience operating in a complex, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Experience managing intake, prioritization, governance, and delivery across cross-functional teams.
Hands-on experience with marketing work management platforms such as Adobe Workfront.
Experience with web and content management platforms; Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) preferred.
Experience working within Agile and/or SAFe delivery models preferred.
Demonstrated success driving outcomes through influence and cross-functional leadership.

Skills

Strong prioritization, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements and delivery plans.
Expertise in process improvement, workflow optimization, and operational excellence.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and evolving business needs.
Continuous improvement mindset focused on scalability, efficiency, and business results.
Excellent collaboration, communication, and relationship-building skills.

Leadership & Influence

Proven ability to lead and influence across cross-functional teams.
Builds alignment among stakeholders with diverse priorities and perspectives.
Brings clarity, structure, and accountability to complex initiatives.
Balances speed, quality, governance, and business outcomes.
Demonstrates ownership and a customer-focused mindset.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.

Presales Systems Engineer – IT Security

Location: home office in the region OR Fortinet Hamburg office

At Fortinet, we are shaping the future of cybersecurity and networking. As a global leader in cybersecurity, we help organizations protect their digital environments and securely accelerate their digital transformation.

We are looking for a passionate IT security professional who enjoys working at the intersection of technology, customers, and business impact. If you thrive on translating complex technical challenges into clear, compelling solutions and enjoy close collaboration with customers and partners, this role is for you.

Fluency in both German and English and confidence presenting in both languages are essential.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Work with one of the industry’s strongest and broadest cybersecurity portfolios

  • Be trusted as a technical authority and strategic advisor, not just a demo resource

  • Influence customer security architectures and long-term strategy

  • Benefit from continuous enablement, certifications, and career development at Fortinet

  • Enjoy high autonomy while being supported by a strong regional and global team

Your Role

This position is part of the German Sales Organization at Fortinet. As a trusted technical advisor, you will work closely with prospective and existing customers to understand their business and technical requirements and demonstrate how Fortinet’s Security Fabric addresses their security challenges.

You will design and deliver persuasive technical presentations, product demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that clearly articulate Fortinet’s value and differentiation.

You will collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and fellow systems engineers, as well as with solution architects, consulting systems engineers, and other internal stakeholders, building long-term relationships based on trust, expertise, and shared success.

You will play a key role in winning strategic customers, accelerating deal cycles through technical leadership, and helping organizations build secure, scalable architectures with Fortinet solutions.

What You Will Do

Product Demonstrations:

Deliver engaging, informative, and customer-focused demonstrations that showcase Fortinet’s market-leading technology and innovation.

Project – the aim you'll have

We are the AI Experience Framework team that builds the platform powering ServiceNow's AI-first user interfaces - an SSR runtime (karuna) built on Lit and server-rendered web components, running behind a multi-tier proxy/HTTP2 routing chain with sharded V8 isolate pools, paired with a ServiceNow Glide/Java platform layer (karuna-glide) that supplies metadata, ACLs, and service artifacts. This role owns production reliability for that stack end to end: Kubernetes deployment and operations, observability, and hands-on troubleshooting of both the Node.js and JVM sides of the system - not generalist infrastructure work.

Position – how you’ll contribute

  • Own Kubernetes deployment and operational health for Framework services, including scaling, rollout/rollback strategy, and resource tuning
  • Build and maintain production observability - Grafana dashboards and Prometheus alerting rules - across the SSR runtime and the Glide platform layer
  • Diagnose and resolve Node.js production incidents: event-loop stalls, heap growth, V8 isolate exhaustion, and isolate-pool scheduling issues under concurrent versioned traffic (vN/vN-1)
  • Diagnose and resolve JVM production incidents on the Glide/Java side: GC pressure, thread dumps, and platform-service latency
  • Own incident response for the team: runbooks, on-call rotation, postmortems, and paging hygiene
  • Drive CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for Kubernetes manifests/Helm and deployment pipelines
  • Partner with the framework engineering team to identify reliability gaps before they become incidents - capacity planning, load testing, chaos/failure-injection where useful
  • Represent production reliability concerns in architecture reviews for new framework capabilities

Expectations – the experience you need

  • Production operations/SRE experience, including hands-on Kubernetes deployment, scaling, and incident response
  • Direct operational experience troubleshooting Node.js in production: reading heap snapshots and CPU profiles, diagnosing event-loop blocking, and understanding process/worker isolation models (V8 isolates or equivalent sandboxing)
  • Direct operational experience troubleshooting JVM-based services in production: GC log analysis, thread dump analysis, and JVM tuning
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining Prometheus alerting rules and Grafana dashboards from scratch, not just consuming existing ones
  • Strong Linux/networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, TCP/HTTP semantics (including HTTP/2), and debugging service-to-service networking inside Kubernetes
  • Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for containerized deployments (Helm, GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD/Flux, or equivalent)
  • Track record owning on-call rotations, writing runbooks, and driving postmortems that lead to real reliability improvements
  • Experience with Splunk for log aggregation, search, and production troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with in-memory caching systems (Valkey/Redis) in production — key design, TTL/eviction tuning, and tenant-scoped cache invalidation
  • Experience managing service-to-service mTLS - certificate issuance, rotation, and format conversion (e.g., PKCS/BCFKS↔PEM) - plus JWT-based service authentication
  • Very good spoken and written English.

Additional skills – the edge you have

  • Familiarity with server-side rendering architectures and the specific failure modes of isomorphic runtimes (markup mismatches, browser-API leakage into server code)
  • Experience operating multi-version/canary rollout strategies (two live app versions served concurrently)
  • Working knowledge of the ServiceNow Glide platform or a comparable enterprise platform integration layer
  • Experience with distributed tracing and request-context correlation across service boundaries
  • Familiarity with event-driven autoscaling (e.g., KEDA ScaledObjects driven by PromQL triggers) as a complement to standard HPA-based scaling

Our offer – professional development, personal growth:

  • Flexible employment and remote work
  • International projects with leading global clients
  • International business trips
  • Non-corporate atmosphere
  • Language classes
  • Internal & external training
  • Private healthcare and insurance
  • Multisport card
  • Well-being initiatives

Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. raw.description:
ABOUT LVT

LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. Since pioneering our first mobile, solar-powered units, our commitment to scrappy, hands-on innovation has made us an established leader and one of the fastest-growing companies in intelligent site technology. We are building the next generation of solutions—from our physical units in the field to a powerful Agentic AI platform—that allows our customers to gain unprecedented visibility and control over safety, compliance, and operations. This is your chance to join a cutting-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it.

We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it.

  • A Top-Tier Growth Company: Named one of the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies 2025 and #10 on the Inc. 5000 Rocky Mountain Regional list for 2025.
  • Innovative Leadership: Our CEO, Ryan Porter, was named an EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025, and our CTO, Steve Lindsey, was inducted into the Silicon Slopes CTO Hall of Fame in 2024.
  • Product & Software Excellence: We were named one of The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023 and are a winner of the Security Today Govies Award for 2025.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on Project Matrix, you will provide durable technical leadership for our embedded cameras ecosystem. You will shape the engineering organization by driving system-wide architecture and identifying technical bets that create a long-term competitive advantage. Your team vertically owns embedded camera development—from device-level software and encoding to storage, streaming, and analytics. Operating within a JDM model, you will leverage Yocto and AI-driven methodologies to build robust edge devices that power LVT’s intelligent site solutions.

This role can be fully remote, or based on-site at our HQ in Utah or in Seattle. Regular travel is expected to our Headquarters in American Fork, Utah (if remote) as well as to our Joint Design Manufacturing (JDM) partners.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • System-Wide Architecture: Own and drive architectural decisions for LVT's embedded camera platforms, ensuring designs hold up over multi-year horizons and support both current capabilities and future technical bets.

  • Domain Ownership: Architect and govern the software running directly on edge devices, as well as the underlying infrastructure for on-camera encoding, video storage, streaming, and retrieval.

  • JDM & Strategic Alignment: Serve as the primary technical authority in a Joint Design Manufacturing (JDM) model, keeping cross-functional work aligned across third-party software partners and internal hardware teams.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Broker alignment by working effectively with Technical Program Managers (TPM) to collaborate seamlessly across Hardware, Product Management (PM), and other Software teams to ensure cohesive product delivery from the edge to the cloud.

  • Tactical Execution & Mentorship: Drive rigorous architecture and code reviews, manage complex schedule planning, and proactively mentor engineers to raise the technical floor of the organization.

  • Edge Analytics & AI: Direct the implementation of camera analytics that translate raw video into actionable signals, utilizing AI-driven tools to enhance design, coding, and automated testing across the development lifecycle.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Senior Technical Leadership: Proven track record as a Staff or Senior Staff Software Engineer capable of navigating high ambiguity, driving engineering process improvements, and turning complex architectural problems into scoped, prioritized work (8+ years of experience total).

  • Embedded & Video Expertise: Deep expertise in embedded Linux environments, custom Yocto distributions, and video processing pipelines, complemented by a foundational understanding of low-level hardware and MCU/RTOS.

  • Analytics Integration: Experience architecting edge-based camera analytics and deploying resource-efficient computer vision or Edge AI models.

  • JDM & Partner Leadership: Demonstrated success driving technical outcomes within a JDM framework, evaluating vendor capabilities, and holding third-party partners to high engineering standards.

  • Engineering Multiplier: Recognized as a technical authority whose judgment generalizes across teams; a leader who actively shapes engineering culture, drives schedule planning, and raises the talent floor.

  • AI Tool Adoption: Proficiency in leveraging AI-driven development tools to accelerate code quality, architecture planning, and overall team efficiency.

BENEFITS

We believe you do your best work when your whole life is supported. We invest in our crew’s health, families, and financial futures with a benefits package designed to support you inside and outside the office. Full-time benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.

LVT IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. All candidates must pass a drug screening and background check upon employment. Some roles may also require passing a federal background check and fingerprinting. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, and/or to perform essential job functions, please reach out to your recruiter.

Overview

The Payer Compliance Specialist I – RCM plays a key role within USAP as it is responsible for analyzing allowed amounts received on USAP claims, to determine appropriateness per contract. This position will review electronic and manual postings associated with variances, appeal for re-processing, and/or request corrections as necessary for USAP to receive the full allowance per contract. Additionally, this position is responsible for working to identify and resolve payer issues that negatively impact receivables.

The Payer Compliance Specialist I – RCM frequently communicates with various internal USAP RCM departments as well as insurance companies. Therefore, it is essential that the candidate demonstrates a positive demeanor, professionalism, and has polished verbal and written communication skills. This position requires independent thinking, problem solving, and strong interpersonal and analytical skills to identify trends and issues along with possible solutions. This position requires the ability to meet deadlines and other requirements set forth by the management team, as well as handle potentially stressful situations and multiple tasks at the same time.

At this time, US Anesthesia Partners does not hire candidates residing in California, Hawaii, or Alaska.

The base pay estimate for this role is $16.49 - $26.39 hourly. The final offer will depend on the skills, experience, and qualifications of the selected candidate. This range is for base pay only and does not include bonuses or other compensation. This position is eligible for a quarterly bonus. Bonuses are not guaranteed and are awarded based on company and individual performance.

Job Highlights

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation)

  • Follows the payer compliance management standard operating procedures.
  • Analyzes, evaluates, and validates payer under and over-allowable variances in work queues.
  • Manages corrective actions to resolve the variances via appeal, cross-workflow, or escalation to management.
  • Gathers appeal documentation and files the appeal to various payers as appropriate.
  • Follows up on appeal results 45-60 days post appeal submission.
  • Partners with leadership to research and report payer systemic issues creating variance trends.
  • Uses the out-of-model guidance matrix to assist with accurately and consistently reporting over-allowed variances to leadership and finance.
  • Learns and familiarizes payer policies and contractual terms associated with the payer to which the analyst is assigned.
  • Researches refund requests sent via correspondence cross-workflow, appropriately responds, and/or takes action.
  • Inquires with leadership and the contract management team on potential contract term discrepancies.
  • Communicates regularly with the management team regarding payer variance issues.

Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • High school graduate or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience in healthcare revenue cycle.
  • Functional knowledge of Excel and Word required.
  • Basic knowledge of managed care programs and healthcare billing requirements necessary.
  • Analytical abilities to identify and resolve underpayments relating to specific payers, coding issues, etc. are required.
  • Good mathematical, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Experience gathering and reporting information.
  • Must display a teamwork attitude and possess good interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Familiarity with basic medical terminology and concepts preferred.
  • Knowledge of CPT, ICD-9, and ASA coding preferred.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that may need to be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Occasional Standing
  • Occasional Walking
  • Frequent Sitting
  • Frequent hand, finger movement
  • Use office equipment (in office or remote)
  • Communicate verbally and in writing

The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Operations Technician III – Federal has an in-depth technical knowledge of network operations to perform circuit and equipment/network restoration. The technician proactively monitors, responds to and resolves network issues and alarms. In the process of network restoration notifies management and program office with risk potential and an impact assessment.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Perform circuit and equipment/network restoration, recognize potential jeopardy conditions.
  • Management of circuits (T1 - 100Gb, Ethernet & IP), perform testing and activation of new network circuits as well as long-haul, metro and international optical networks.
  • Work very closely with Federal government network operation centers (NOC) customers for all demand and scheduled maintenance to conform to customer network management requirements and protocols.
  • Analyze network troubles, assess performance data and develop design optimization plans accordingly.
  • Interface with fiber vendors, telecom providers and other entities on complex technical matters.
  • Participate as a Lead/SME to select customers to participate in regular customer meetings, procedural reviews, audits, and other functions
  • Review and interpret electric data processing (EDP) and as-built engineering documentation.
  • Coordinate and track return material authorization (RMA) requests, including vendor interface to obtain RMA authorization requests and completion of RMA submittal forms.
  • Analyze, test and repair Layer 2/3 network problems. Ensure services conform to customer mandated SLAs for latency, packet loss, jitter, throughput. Ability to test using standard protocols, as well as Iperf and Brix platforms.

raw.description:
If you’re excited about building systems that empower others to lead and want to help shape Canada’s next generation of entrepreneurial, AI-ready talent for the future of work, we’d love to hear from you!

Venture for Canada is a national registered charity equipping talent across Canada with the entrepreneurial skills, mindset, and opportunities to succeed in a 21st-century economy increasingly shaped by rapid change and emerging technology. We believe that to be entrepreneurial is to act upon opportunities to create value for others. The resourcefulness and creativity of people across Canada are essential to addressing our country’s greatest challenges. Venture for Canada serves as a catalyst by empowering individuals to create a more prosperous, inclusive, and innovative society.

Since 2013, Venture for Canada has grown in meaningful ways, and we’re excited to expand our team with values-aligned individuals who can contribute to what we’re building. To learn more about our hiring process and workplace philosophy, visit our Careers page.

Role Overview

The Manager, Business Development is responsible for driving participation in Venture for Canada’s programs through proactive business development, prospecting, and relationship-building.

The role has two core portfolios:

  1. Employer acquisition – building a pipeline of SMEs and employers for VFC’s Internship, Intrapreneurship, AI Adoption, and other employer-facing programs.
  2. Institutional partnerships – developing relationships with post-secondary institutions, incubators, accelerators, and other organizations that can drive program enrolment, bulk seat purchases, and white-labelled program sales.

The relative focus across employer acquisition and institutional partnerships may shift over the course of the contract based on VFC’s program priorities, growth targets, and capacity needs.

This is a results-driven role for someone who enjoys prospecting, opening doors, pitching, building relationships, and converting interest into measurable program growth.

Key Role Responsibilities

Employer Acquisition

  • Build and manage a national pipeline of prospective SMEs and employer communities for Venture for Canada’s employer-facing programs
  • Proactively identify, prospect, and engage new employers through outbound outreach, referrals, networking, events, and other business development channels
  • Develop relationships with business networks, industry associations, chambers of commerce, and other organizations that provide scalable access to prospective employers
  • Clearly articulate Venture for Canada’s value proposition and generate qualified employer interest in participating in Venture for Canada programs
  • Consistently follow up with prospective employers and move opportunities toward submission of an employer interest form
  • Develop and deliver employer-facing webinars, presentations, information sessions, and other activities designed to generate employer leads
  • Attend relevant business and industry events to generate leads, build relationships, and promote Venture for Canada programs
  • Identify and test new employer acquisition channels and outreach strategies
  • Develop repeatable business development approaches that allow Venture for Canada to efficiently scale employer acquisition
  • Meet established targets for employer pipeline, qualified leads, and employer interest generated

Institutional Partnerships & Program Growth

  • Build and manage a pipeline of post-secondary institutions, incubators, accelerators, employers, and other organizations that provide access to VFC’s target program participants.
  • Proactively identify, prospect, and engage institutional partners through outbound outreach, networking, referrals, and events.
  • Build referral relationships that generate qualified prospective participants for VFC’s programs.
  • Identify and sell opportunities for institutions to purchase bulk program seats or white-labelled VFC programming for their students, members, or communities.
  • Lead institutional business development from initial outreach through presentations, proposals, negotiation, and close.
  • Develop and deliver webinars, presentations, and information sessions with partners to drive program awareness and enrolment.
  • Attend relevant post-secondary, entrepreneurship, and recruitment events to generate leads and develop institutional relationships.
  • Track referrals, enrolments, institutional sales, and revenue generated through these channels.
  • Meet established targets for institutional pipeline, participant referrals, enrolment, and program sales.

Pipeline, Performance & Reporting

  • Maintain an accurate and actionable employer acquisition pipeline with clear stages, next steps, and follow-up
  • Maintain accurate CRM records of employer prospects, outreach, opportunities, and outcomes
  • Track employer acquisition activity, conversion rates, lead sources, and channel performance
  • Use pipeline and performance data to prioritize activity and focus resources on the highest-performing acquisition channels and opportunities
  • Provide regular reporting and forecasts against employer acquisition targets
  • Identify barriers to employer acquisition and recommend changes to outreach, messaging, channels, or Venture for Canada’s employer value proposition
  • Develop and document repeatable employer acquisition processes and playbooks

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Programs to understand program capacity, eligibility, timelines, and upcoming acquisition needs
  • Work closely with Marketing to develop campaigns, collateral, webinars, events, and communications that support business development
  • Coordinate with Student Programs when engaging employers already within Venture for Canada’s network to avoid duplication and ensure a consistent employer experience
  • Share employer and market insights with Program, Marketing, and leadership teams to strengthen Venture for Canada’s value proposition and acquisition strategy
  • Refer opportunities outside the role’s employer acquisition mandate to the appropriate internal owner

Who You Are

  • You are a proactive business developer who enjoys prospecting, opening doors, starting conversations, and building pipeline
  • You are comfortable with outbound sales and business development and are motivated by clear acquisition and growth targets
  • You are an excellent relationship builder who can quickly establish credibility with entrepreneurs, post-secondary institutions, SME leaders, and business organizations
  • You are persistent and resilient and understand that successful business development requires consistent outreach and follow-through
  • You are commercially minded and naturally look for efficient ways to reach and convert prospective employers
  • You are comfortable experimenting with different acquisition channels, messages, and approaches and using results to determine where to focus
  • You take ownership of your pipeline and are comfortable independently figuring out how to reach a target
  • You are highly organized and disciplined about CRM management, follow-up, and tracking results
  • You are curious about businesses and interested in understanding the challenges and opportunities facing Canadian SMEs and entrepreneurs
  • You are a confident communicator and presenter who is comfortable hosting webinars, networking, and representing Venture for Canada externally

What You Bring

  • 3–5+ years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, or a related role
  • Demonstrated success building pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting and converting prospects into measurable results
  • Experience developing new business relationships from initial prospecting through qualification and handoff or close
  • Experience working with SMEs, entrepreneurs, or business owners is strongly preferred
  • Experience developing or leveraging channel relationships, referral networks, associations, or other scalable approaches to customer acquisition is an asset
  • Familiarity with Canada’s entrepreneurship, small business, economic development, workforce development, or innovation landscape is an asset
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Strong CRM and pipeline management skills, with the ability to use data to prioritize activity and improve conversion
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through
  • Strong ownership and initiative, with the ability to independently build a pipeline and move opportunities forward
  • Willingness to travel and attend external events as required

Job Details

The purpose of this job posting is to fill a temporary vacancy created by an employee leave of absence. The contract term is 12 months. The anticipated start date is immediate.

Arrangement

Venture for Canada is a remote-first organization with offices based in Toronto and Vancouver. This is a remote position open to candidates across Canada. While all qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, preference may be given to candidates based in the Toronto, Ontario area to support occasional in-person collaboration. Light in-person attendance of program-related events during evenings and weekends is required.

Language Requirement

As a national organization serving communities across Canada, professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in both English and French is considered a strong asset for this role.

Commitment to Diversity and Accessibility

Venture for Canada is dedicated to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and accessible workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all stages of the recruitment and selection process. If you require an accommodation, please contact .

Applicant Notice

Venture for Canada may use artificial intelligence-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by our talent acquisition stakeholders. Only selected applicants will be contacted for an interview. In accordance with applicable laws, candidates who are interviewed will be notified of the hiring decision within 45 days of their final interview. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of application; we are unable to provide employment sponsorship or support work permit applications for this position.

Salary: $70,000-$80,000

  • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs for ReliaSoft Desktop and ReliaSoft Cloud.

Head of Client Operations – Cold Email, Client Success & Startup Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible with U.S. Time Zone Collaboration

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Head of Client Operations to own client delivery, cold email campaign performance, retention, and operational execution inside a fast-growing startup.

This is not a traditional project management or client support role.

You’ll take direct ownership of:

  • Client relationships and satisfaction
  • Cold email campaign performance
  • Retention and churn prevention
  • Deliverability and campaign infrastructure
  • Client delivery systems
  • Operational processes and scalability

You’ll work directly with the founder, developers, outreach teams, and operations to ensure campaigns produce measurable results while improving the systems required to support rapid growth.

If you’ve worked inside a cold email agency, lead generation company, outbound growth business, or fast-growing startup and can personally troubleshoot campaigns rather than simply coordinate others, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Client Relationships & Retention

  • Own relationships across 20–30 active client accounts
  • Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the client lifecycle
  • Lead:
    • Client check-ins
    • Strategic conversations
    • Performance discussions
    • Ongoing communication
  • Set and manage client expectations proactively
  • Identify churn risks before they become problems
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with clients
  • Ensure clients remain informed, supported, and confident in delivery
  • Take direct accountability for client satisfaction and retention

Cold Email Campaign Performance

  • Review campaign performance across active client accounts
  • Diagnose and improve:
    • Underperforming campaigns
    • Low reply rates
    • Poor meeting conversion
    • Deliverability problems
    • Inbox placement issues
    • Weak messaging
  • Quality-check campaigns before launch
  • Ensure campaigns are technically and strategically ready to send
  • Review and optimize:
    • Copy
    • Targeting
    • Lists
    • Sending infrastructure
    • Campaign setup
  • Personally step into campaigns when execution or troubleshooting is required

Deliverability & Email Infrastructure

  • Own campaign execution quality across:
    • Inbox warm-up
    • Domain health
    • Deliverability
    • List quality
    • Sending infrastructure
  • Diagnose spam placement and inboxing problems
  • Understand and troubleshoot:
    • DNS configurations
    • SPF / DKIM / DMARC
    • API issues
    • Integration failures
    • Automation breakdowns
  • Partner with developers on technical issues while remaining capable of diagnosing problems independently
  • Improve campaign reliability and deliverability standards across accounts

Processes, Systems & Operational Scalability

  • Build and improve operational playbooks
  • Create repeatable systems for:
    • Client onboarding
    • Campaign launches
    • Campaign QA
    • Client communication
    • Performance reviews
    • Escalations
  • Track:
    • SLAs
    • Client health
    • Delivery performance
    • Campaign metrics
    • Operational bottlenecks
  • Identify inefficient or unreliable workflows and improve them
  • Build enough structure to support growth without slowing execution

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Coordinate closely with:
    • Developers
    • Outreach specialists
    • Operations teams
    • Leadership
  • Report directly to the founder on:
    • Client health
    • Churn risks
    • Campaign performance
    • Delivery issues
    • Operational priorities
  • Ensure teams remain aligned on client outcomes and delivery expectations
  • Drive issues through resolution rather than simply escalating them

AI & Automation

  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude in day-to-day operations
  • Apply AI to:
    • Campaign analysis
    • Copywriting
    • Client communication
    • Research
    • Documentation
    • Workflow improvement
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational processes
  • Combine AI, APIs, and automation systems to improve delivery efficiency

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Experience leading:
    • Client Operations
    • Client Success
    • Account Ownership
    • Delivery Operations
  • Experience inside a fast-growing startup, agency, or similarly high-ownership environment
  • Strong professional background in:
    • Cold email
    • Lead generation
    • Outbound operations
  • Hands-on expertise with:
    • Email deliverability
    • Inbox placement
    • Domain warm-up
    • Campaign optimization
    • Cold email copywriting
  • Ability to personally diagnose and troubleshoot campaign problems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • APIs
    • Automations
    • Workflows
    • Operational systems
  • Practical day-to-day experience using AI tools such as:
    • ChatGPT
    • Claude
    • Similar AI workflow tools
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Confidence communicating directly with founders, executives, and clients
  • Ability to operate independently in a rapidly changing environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with platforms such as:
    • Instantly
    • Smartlead
    • Clay
    • Apollo
    • HubSpot
  • Experience managing high-volume outbound campaigns
  • Strong familiarity with:
    • DNS
    • SPF
    • DKIM
    • DMARC
    • Email infrastructure
  • Experience scaling client delivery inside an agency or startup
  • Experience building client health or churn-prevention systems
  • Technical familiarity with integrations and automation infrastructure

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Think like an operator rather than a coordinator
  • Understand cold email beyond surface-level campaign management
  • Can personally diagnose why a campaign isn’t performing
  • Take ownership of client outcomes instead of waiting for direction
  • Communicate confidently with clients, founders, and technical teams
  • Stay effective when priorities change quickly
  • Build processes without becoming overly dependent on process
  • Are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information
  • Focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and retention
  • Thrive in high-accountability startup environments

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review client health and campaign performance
  • Identify accounts at risk of churn
  • Diagnose deliverability or inbox placement problems
  • Review campaign copy and targeting
  • Meet with clients and communicate performance updates
  • Troubleshoot campaign infrastructure
  • Coordinate technical fixes with developers
  • Review lists, domains, and sending infrastructure
  • Improve onboarding or campaign QA processes
  • Update operational playbooks
  • Report risks and priorities directly to the founder

In short: you ensure clients stay happy, campaigns perform, problems get solved quickly, and delivery operations become more scalable as the company grows.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Client retention and churn reduction
  • Campaign performance improvement
  • Reply and positive response rates
  • Meeting conversion performance
  • Deliverability and inbox placement health
  • Client satisfaction
  • SLA adherence
  • Speed of issue resolution
  • Operational consistency and scalability
  • Leadership confidence in client delivery

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct ownership of client success and delivery
  • Work closely with the founder and leadership
  • High autonomy and decision-making responsibility
  • Opportunity to shape:
    • Client delivery systems
    • Operational processes
    • Campaign standards

raw.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic Experiences
raw.excerpt: Who We Are At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online.
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

We are entering the agentic era. Our customers — small business owners and the professionals who serve them — will increasingly get work done bydelegating toagents rather than clicking through screens. Across the companywe are building a growing portfolio of business and product agents: agents that build andoptimizewebsites, agents that market, agents that support andretain, agents that sell, agents that manage the account.Individuallythey are powerful. Stitched together, they become the product.

That stitchingisthis role. The Principal PM, AgenticExperiences owns the connective layer — how a fleet of independently-built agents shows up to the customer as one coherent, trustworthy, frictionless experience, across every interface we expose: the customer portal, our APIs, MCP servers, and third-party connectors and channels.

This is a highly cross-functional, high-visibility individual contributor role for someone who thinks in systems, has strong product taste, and canoperatein a product-led organization where influence matters more than reporting lines.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

The agentexperiencearchitecture.Define the end-to-end model for how agents are discovered, invoked, handed off between, and held accountable to the customer. Own the shared primitives — identity and permissions, context and memory, intent routing, hand-off and escalation, human-in-the-loop approval, transparency and traceability,guardrailsand fallback.

Connectingthe dots to the customer.Translate a portfolio ofinternally-ownedagents into a single customer narrative: what the customer can ask for, what happens when they do, how they know it worked, and what it costs. Own the customer journey across agents, not just the agents.

The interface surface strategy.Set the strategy for how agentic capability is exposed across:

  • Portal— conversational and ambient agent surfaces inside the logged-in experience, alongside and eventually in place of traditional navigation

  • APIs— clean, agent-consumable contracts over our commerce, hosting, domains, and account systems

  • MCP— our capabilities as tools that both our own agents and external agents (Claude, ChatGPT, IDEs, partner platforms) can call safely

  • Connectors & channels— bringing our agents to where the customer already works, and bringing their tools into ours

Standards andthe operatingmodel.Establish the shared patterns, quality bars, and interaction standards that let a dozen teams ship agents independently without fragmenting the experience.Define what "good" looks like — latency, accuracy, containment, escalation, tone, disclosure — and the review mechanism that holds it.

Measurement.Define the metric framework for agentic experience: task success and completion rate, hand-off and containment, time-to-value, trust and intervention rates, and the downstream commercial impact on conversion, attach, and retention.

Roadmap and influence.Build the multi-quarter roadmap for the connective layer, and drive alignment across product, engineering, data, design, care, and marketing to sequence it. Partner especially closely with Data & Personalization — agents are only as good as the context and signals they act on.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • 10+ years in product management, includingsignificant timeon platform, API, or ecosystem products, and time on customer-facing experiences. You have shipped both.

  • Demonstrated ownership of an AI or agentic product surface— assistants, copilots, automation, orchestration, or tool-calling systems in production, with real users and real accountability for outcomes.

  • Deep technical fluency.You can hold a credible design conversation about LLM orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP, RAG and context strategy, evals, latency and cost trade-offs, and where the failure modes live. You do not need to write the code; you do need to know whatyou'reasking for.

  • API and platform product judgment.You understand what makes an interface a good contract, and you have opinions about versioning, permissions, and developer experience.

  • Systems thinker,experience-obsessed.You naturally see the seams between products — and you care, viscerally, when a customer hits one.

  • Exceptional influence without authority.You can align senior stakeholders across a matrixed, product-led organization, and drive convergence on standards teamsactually adopt.

  • Strong written communication.You write the doc that makes twelve teams agree.

  • Bias to ship.You'drather land a real, narrow agentic journey end-to-end this quarter than a perfect framework next year.

Nice tohave:experience in hosting, domains, web presence, SMB SaaS, or e-commerce; experience with agent evaluation and observability tooling; experience building or publishing MCP servers or public developer platforms.

What Success Looks Like:

  • First90 days— a shared, agreed map of every agent in flight across the business; a documented target-state agent experience architecture; one prioritized customer journey selected for end-to-end stitching.

  • Six months— that journey shipped across at least two interfaces (portal plus API or MCP), with a live measurement framework and adopted interaction standards.

  • Twelve months— a functioning connective layer other teams build on by default, measurable improvement in task success and time-to-value, and a credible external agent story for partners and third-party platforms.

The target compensation range for this position is $150,000 to $190,000 annually. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to: candidate’s qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience, as well as internal equity and market conditions.

Why You'll Love Working Here

There is a lot to love about working at VistaPrint. We are an award winning Remote-First company. We’re an inclusive community. We’re growing (which means you can too). About Us

For over 20 years we’ve been inspired by small businesses, and we work incessantly to deliver solutions to their evolving needs. Together, VistaCreate, 99designs by Vista and VistaPrint represent a full-service design, digital and print solution, elevating small businesses’ presence in physical and digital spaces and powering them to achieve success. Commitment to Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion

VistaPrint exists to help our customers live their dreams. Each dream is unique – and the VistaPrint team needs to be as well. Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

We don't care about a traditional animation degree or a corporate agency resume; we care about the physics, timing, and visual weight of your reel. If you have the drive to master our core layout principles, the speed to match our rapid product updates, and the structural discipline to deliver clean, highly optimized assets that integrate flawlessly with modern UI layers, we will give you the ultimate digital stage to build your legacy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Kinetic Character & Asset Design: Animate characters, environments, and custom icons, preserving absolute volumetric integrity, weight, and visual energy across every sequence.

  • VFX Engineering: Conceptualize and execute high-octane visual effects that amplify high-stakes actions, user milestones, and critical interactive touchpoints.

The Software Toolkit

  • Adobe After Effects (AE): Advanced keyframing, parenting, expression scripting, and heavy visual effects (VFX) composition.

  • Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to align with fast-moving code releases and global launch schedules).

Why Join Us?

We offer more than just a standard motion graphics gig; we offer the runway to drive the visual rhythm of a global powerhouse.

  • Absolute Creative Sovereignty: We value raw output and kinetic impact over corporate red tape. If your motion frameworks are sharp and move the needle, we push them live.

  • A Culture of Momentum: Join a fast-moving, internet-native team that moves at lightspeed. You will be constantly creating, testing new visual boundaries, and seeing your technical execution hit production instantly.
