What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on the quality and accuracy of entry-level competition math questions. High-quality assessments require technically flawless questions, unambiguous distractor options, and robust grading logic. This review process helps ensure our Elementary Math Olympiad materials are rigorous, fair, and perfectly structured for digital platforms.

How It Works

During this AI-moderated interview, you will review a JSON payload containing several math problems, options, and rubrics. You will audit each multiple-choice question for technical accuracy and verify that the distractor choices are clear and unambiguous. Additionally, you will evaluate the provided rubrics and suggest edge cases to strengthen the grading logic. Finally, you will provide feedback on the data structure based on your mathematical expertise.

Who This Is For

We are looking for math educators, curriculum developers, and academic competition coaches with strong mathematical fundamentals. Ideal candidates have experience creating or grading assessments for elementary or middle school math olympiads. We welcome teachers, private tutors, and educational content creators who are comfortable reading and reviewing basic JSON structures.

What You'll Do

  • Audit multiple-choice math questions for technical accuracy and correctness

  • Evaluate distractor options to eliminate ambiguity for test-taking students

  • Review grading rubrics to ensure they clearly explain the correct mathematical reasoning

  • Propose edge cases and test conditions to strengthen the assessment logic

  • Validate the final structured data containing the approved questions and answers

Who Should Apply

  • Professional experience as a math educator, tutor, or curriculum developer

  • Familiarity with elementary or middle school competition math concepts

raw.excerpt: When you join VerizonYou want more out of a career.
raw.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be a senior individual contributor on a platform team that builds and secures the internal microservices powering enterprise identity operations at Verizon — Active Directory management, access provisioning, privileged account lifecycle, and the services that tie it all together.

You won't just be handed tickets. You'll own services, investigate problems from first principles, and ship solutions that hold up under scrutiny from both an engineering and a security lens. Responsibilities may include:

Service Development & Maintenance

  • Build and maintain microservices within a shared .NET framework (Micro.Framework, SharedServices, WebTools).
  • Implement feature work, bug fixes, and platform upgrades across a large service fleet — async pattern improvements, framework version migrations, NuGet dependency updates.
  • Contribute to breaking-change analysis when shared libraries evolve: understand downstream impact, validate that consumer contracts hold.
  • Build and maintain SCIM provisioning integrations that automate identity lifecycle events (create, update, deprovision) across enterprise systems.
  • Develop and manage API proxies, policies, Automation, and traffic management in Apigee for services exposed internally and externally.

Security Remediation & Hardening

  • Implement security remediations identified through assessment, spanning application-layer vulnerabilities and security configuration hardening.
  • Apply cloud-native secrets management patterns: Key Vault integration, Managed Identity, encrypted connections, and proper JWT validation.
  • Write secure code by default — parameterized queries, input validation at system boundaries, least-privilege service accounts.

Security Assessment Participation

  • Participate in white-box security reviews of internal services — reading code with an attacker's eye, identifying common application-layer vulnerabilities.
  • Document findings with enough specificity to be actionable: file paths, line numbers, CVSS context, reproduction steps.
  • Translate security findings into working code fixes, not just recommendations.

AI-Augmented Development

  • Use AI coding assistants actively in your daily workflow — for large refactors, codebase comprehension, documentation, and repetitive pattern application across multiple services.
  • Know where AI output needs validation and when to course-correct.

What We're Looking For

You've built enough software to have opinions about what breaks in production, and you've been around enough security incidents (or near-misses) to take credential hygiene seriously without being told twice. You can read unfamiliar code and quickly build a mental model of what it does, what it trusts, and where it could go wrong. When you find a security issue — whether it's a missing input sanitization call, an unsafe configuration value, or an inconsistently applied pattern — you don't just flag it, you fix it and make sure the fix is applied consistently across every occurrence in the codebase. You work well with a principal who sets direction: you can take a remediation roadmap or an architectural decision and execute it thoroughly, flag edge cases you find along the way, and deliver work that doesn't require rework.

You'll Need to Have:

  • Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Four or more years of relevant work experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
  • Four or more years of software engineering experience.
  • .NET (C#) development skills specifically with async/await, dependency injection, REST API design, and common framework patterns.
  • Experience with injection vulnerabilities (SQL, LDAP), authentication/authorization patterns, and secure configuration practices.
  • Experience working in a microservice or service-oriented architecture.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Comfort reading and reasoning about unfamiliar codebases — you can navigate a large repo, understand data flow, and identify where trust boundaries exist.
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory concepts: users, groups, OUs, permissions — enough to understand what the services you're working on actually do.
  • Security+ or equivalent foundational security knowledge.
  • Hands-on experience with OWASP Top 10 or OWASP API Security Top 10 — not just awareness, but having found or fixed examples.
  • Exposure to secrets scanning tools (TruffleHog, GitLeaks) or SAST tooling in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience integrating with or debugging Active Directory operations (LDAP queries, group membership, account management).
  • Familiarity with CyberArk or other PAM platforms.
  • JWT / OAuth 2.0 — understanding how tokens are issued, validated, and where they can be abused.
  • Azure DevOps or GitLab pipeline experience.
  • Experience working with shared internal NuGet packages or internal frameworks — understanding how breaking changes propagate.
  • EF Core, database connection management, migration patterns.
  • Experience using AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) as a real accelerator on day-to-day engineering work.
  • Track record of producing clear technical documentation — not just for external audiences, but the kind that helps the next engineer understand what a service does and why

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box above.

Where you’ll be working

In this remote role, you'll work from home with occasional in-person trainings and meetings.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $111,500.00 - $194,000.00.

This career level professional performs complex compliance activities supporting major grants from the U.S. Government (USG) and other multilateral funders. This specialist ensures overall compliance and risk mitigation related to grant agreements (also including subgrants, subcontracts, purchase orders, and consulting agreements) and the solicitation and award processes for those subgrant agreements. This incumbent collaborates as needed with legal and operational teams to ensure grant agreements, contracts, and compliance activities meet legal and donor standards. He/she may serve as a resource and collaborator with program teams on broader grant compliance matters. At this level, the incumbent generally implements or contributes to grant compliance projects independently or participates as a team member for major, complex initiatives. This professional may coach and oversee the work of others.

What do you bring?

  • Maintains a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Is a consistent witness for Jesus Christ, maintains a courteous, Christ-like attitude in dealing with people within and outside of Compassion, and faithfully upholds Compassion’s ministry in prayer.

  • Acts as an advocate to raise the awareness of the needs of children. Understands Christ’s mandate to protect children. Commits to and prioritizes child protection considerations in all decision-making, tasks and activities across the ministry. Abides by all behavioral expectations in Compassion’s Statement of Commitment to Child Protection and Code of Conduct. Reports any concerns of abuse, neglect or exploitation of children through Compassion’s internal reporting process and appropriately supports responses to incidents if they occur.

  • Reviews and negotiates complex grant-related awards, subawards and associated contracts (e.g. Teaming Agreements) ensuring compliance with donor and legal requirements; including the acquisition and maintenance of appropriate certifications for grant funding (e.g. sam.gov, U.S. Government registrations registrations for grants).

  • Ensures compliance with donor rules, regulations, and legal frameworks at federal, state, and international levels. Assists Legal Department with interpretation of grant agreement terms and regulatory changes, providing guidance to program teams on compliance with legal and donor requirements.

  • Facilitates subrecipient and vendor vetting, including coordinating due diligence, sanctions checks, and performance assessments to ensure compliance with donor regulations. Coordinates review, negotiation, and execution of contracts, ensuring alignment with legal frameworks, donor regulations, and project budgets in collaboration with the Finance team.

  • Supports the growth of organizational capacity for managing high-value and high-risk grants with minimal compliance and legal exposure, coordinating, developing and providing formal training on relevant policies, USG and other donor compliance rules (e.g. 2 CFR 200 regulations).

  • May conduct grant-related procurement and sourcing activities. This may include things such as: providing consultation regarding the procurement manual and standards; ensuing goods and services procured for grant programs and operations adhere to internal and donor policies and pre-approvals; ensuring grant-funded projects comply with budgets and procurement strategies; and ensuring all required documentation of such acquisitions and transactions for goods and services are in alignment with documentation and audit standards.

Runs competitive subaward solicitations, as required, ensuring clear alignment to established grant requirements. raw.description:
Sales Account Executive (B2B Sales & Full-Cycle Closing) – Remote | EST Hours

Location: Mexico, Colombia, Costa Rica, Brazil
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. EST Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Account Executive to own the full B2B sales cycle — from prospecting and pipeline generation through discovery, presentations, negotiation, and closing.

This is a full-cycle sales role, not an order-taking or account support position.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • B2B prospecting and pipeline generation
  • Discovery calls and sales presentations
  • Full-cycle deal management
  • Negotiation and closing
  • CRM and pipeline management
  • Revenue growth
  • Client relationship management

If you have a proven track record of hitting quota, closing B2B deals, and owning the sales process from prospect to close, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle B2B Sales

Own the complete sales cycle:

  • Prospecting
  • Outbound outreach
  • Lead qualification
  • Discovery calls
  • Product or service presentations
  • Follow-ups
  • Negotiation
  • Closing

You will:

  • Generate new opportunities through outbound and inbound channels
  • Qualify prospects based on business needs, budget, and buying intent
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities
  • Move deals efficiently through each stage of the sales funnel
  • Consistently work toward monthly and quarterly revenue targets

Discovery, Presentations & Closing

  • Lead consultative discovery calls with prospective clients
  • Identify business challenges, goals, pain points, and buying motivations
  • Present solutions tailored to each prospect’s needs
  • Handle objections confidently and professionally
  • Navigate negotiations with business owners and decision-makers
  • Create urgency and maintain momentum throughout the sales process
  • Close deals and ensure a smooth transition to onboarding

Client & Executive Relationship Management

Build strong relationships with:

  • Business owners
  • Executives
  • Senior decision-makers
  • Key stakeholders

Maintain professional communication throughout the sales process and build trust through a consultative, relationship-driven approach.

Pipeline Management & Forecasting

  • Maintain accurate CRM records in Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms
  • Track:
    • Opportunities
    • Deal stages
    • Follow-ups
    • Next steps
    • Expected close dates
  • Maintain strong pipeline hygiene and visibility
  • Forecast revenue and upcoming closes accurately
  • Monitor conversion rates and deal velocity
  • Identify stalled opportunities and take action to move them forward

Sales Performance & Optimization

  • Analyze individual sales performance and pipeline trends
  • Identify opportunities to improve:
    • Conversion rates
    • Win rates
    • Deal velocity
    • Revenue
  • Refine outreach, discovery, follow-up, and closing approaches based on performance
  • Maintain consistent activity and execution against targets

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Customer Success
  • Operations
  • Leadership

Ensure closed deals transition smoothly into onboarding and delivery.

Share prospect and customer insights that can help improve sales strategy, positioning, and the overall client experience.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 3+ years of experience in:
    • B2B Sales
    • Account Executive roles
    • Business Development
  • Proven track record of hitting or exceeding sales quotas
  • Demonstrated experience closing B2B deals
  • Experience owning the full sales cycle from prospecting through close
  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills
  • Strong negotiation and objection-handling ability
  • Experience using:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Or similar CRM platforms
  • Strong pipeline and time-management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Comfortable selling to business owners, executives, and decision-makers
  • Ability to work independently in a remote sales environment
  • Availability during U.S. EST business hours
  • Must be based in Mexico, Colombia, Costa Rica, or Brazil

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling for:
    • B2B service companies
    • SaaS businesses
    • Professional services firms
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Experience mentoring SDRs, BDRs, or junior sales representatives
  • Strong forecasting and sales reporting experience
  • Consistent career progression within sales
  • Experience managing longer or more complex B2B sales cycles

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re competitive and motivated by measurable results
  • You know how to prospect, sell, negotiate, and close
  • You build relationships rather than relying on transactional selling
  • You’re comfortable owning a revenue target
  • You maintain strong follow-up discipline
  • You can manage multiple active opportunities without losing visibility
  • You communicate confidently with executive-level buyers
  • You take ownership of your pipeline and results
  • You thrive in quota-driven, performance-focused environments

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Prospecting and following up with potential clients
  • Qualifying inbound and outbound opportunities
  • Running discovery calls
  • Delivering sales presentations or demos
  • Following up on active opportunities
  • Handling objections and negotiating terms
  • Closing deals
  • Updating CRM records and forecasts
  • Reviewing pipeline health and upcoming opportunities
  • Coordinating closed deals with onboarding and internal teams

In short: you own the sales process from initial opportunity through close and drive revenue by consistently building pipeline, developing relationships, and winning business.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Monthly and quarterly revenue attainment
  • Quota achievement
  • Lead-to-close conversion rate
  • Qualified pipeline generated
  • Win rate
  • Deal velocity
  • Forecast accuracy
  • CRM and pipeline accuracy
  • Consistency of sales activity
  • Client satisfaction following handoff

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Full ownership of the B2B sales cycle
  • Direct impact on company revenue
  • Opportunity to sell directly to business owners and executives
  • High-performance, results-driven environment
  • Fully remote role
  • Clear opportunities to grow into:
    • Senior Account Executive
    • Sales Manager
    • Sales Director
    • Revenue Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Recruiter Interview
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have a proven B2B sales track record
  • Consistently hit or exceed quota
  • Know how to prospect, run discovery, negotiate, and close
  • Enjoy relationship-driven selling
  • Want direct ownership of revenue outcomes

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of a full-cycle B2B sales pipeline in a high-performance remote environment.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This gives you an opportunity to introduce yourself, highlight your B2B sales experience, and share your track record of managing pipelines, hitting quotas, and closing deals.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

raw.description:
As the Senior Advisor, Industry and Ecosystem Engagement for BC at ICTC, you will be a key connector between industry, innovation ecosystems and workforce development initiatives—playing a strategic role in driving the scale up of BC-based high-growth companies and, ensuring they can compete globally in a digitally evolving marketplace. You will work at the intersection of business and technology, leveraging your established industry network to influence lasting change within the technology ecosystem.

This role involves identifying new business opportunities, building strong relationships with BC-based businesses, and meeting program growth and revenue targets. You will play a critical role in expanding our presence in the BC market.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Relationship Development:
    • Lead strategic account development for a portfolio of key industry partners, maintaining “trusted advisor” status while developing comprehensive digital talent strategies;
    • Develop and implement a business growth strategy to identify and pursue new business opportunities in BC.
    • Identify potential clients, initiate contact, and develop strong relationships to convert leads into long-term partnerships to deepen engagement with ICTC programs, services and resources;
    • Act as the primary liaison for BC-based businesses, ensuring client satisfaction and retention through effective communication and service delivery.
    • Ensure ICTC meets or exceeds its targets for participation of BC stakeholders in all ICTC programs through proactive client engagement and market research.
    • Lead negotiations to secure mutually beneficial contracts with new and existing partners.
    • Provide regular updates and reports on business development activities, performance metrics, and progress toward targets, including leveraging Salesforce and other business development tools.
  • Advisory and Implementation:
    • Provide expert guidance throughout the technology adoption and talent development cycle—from assessing skills needs by BC-based companies, to identifying barriers to technology adoption, to implementing tailored programs and managing ongoing partnerships;
    • Collaborate with internal teams to design and deliver integrated initiatives that meet industry needs and align with ICTC’s broader mission of strengthening Canada’s digital advantage;
    • Ensure BC-based companies have a voice in all future program development and continuous improvement of existing programs.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy:
    • Develop and implement sector-specific strategies to identify common needs across key sectors in BC and capitalize on the adoption of emerging technologies;
    • Gather, analyze, and synthesize market intelligence to inform strategic direction and program development at ICTC.
    • Stay up-to-date with market trends, competitive insights, and regional business developments to refine strategies and offerings.
  • Content and Messaging:
    • Contribute to the development of strategic content and messaging that clearly articulates ICTC’s value proposition to our industry partners and stakeholders in BC.
    • Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, product development, customer success) to enhance service offerings for BC businesses.

What You Bring to This Position:

  • Master's degree or equivalent with 5+ years of relevant experience and/or expertise in the technology sector
  • A sales-mindset and 5+ years of experience in business development, sales, or account management in the BC market;
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding business development and program targets;
  • A strong, established industry network in BC and a deep understanding of BC’s business landscape, market, and culture;
  • A proven track record in building and maintaining strategic relationships with senior stakeholders and key industry influencers in BC;
  • Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills with the ability to build trust with a diverse clientele;
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights;
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the capacity to engage effectively at all organizational levels;
  • Strategic thinking with the practical ability to drive initiatives from concept to execution;
  • Experience in project management and stakeholder coordination;
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office Suite;

What Sets You Apart:

  • Demonstrated success in identifying, developing, and managing complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships.
  • Proven experience in digital transformation, workforce development, or technology capacity building.
  • A record of contributing to strategic initiatives that extend beyond routine responsibilities.
  • Adaptability and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Are you?

  • An inspirational leader- Are you someone who motivates others, drives meaningful change, and navigates challenges with grace and resilience?
  • Driven and Determined - Are you highly motivated, self-starting, and willing to go above and beyond expectations with the drive to improve and exceed goals?
  • Optimism with a “can-do”, results-driven orientation – Are you able to think creatively and successfully navigate barriers and obstacles? Do you stay focused on achieving priority goals and results?
  • Dynamic, resilient, and flexible - Are you able to keep up with and embrace the rapid pace of change, advances in technology, intense competition and unparalleled levels of uncertainty? Are you open to change, evolving requirements, continuous feedback, and have the capacity to work with remote teams across Canada?
  • A strategic, creative thinker – Are you skilled in analyzing complex situations and relationships? Are you able to channel your curiosity to navigate intricate challenges and drive innovation? Do you identify inter-relationships, patterns, and trends while noticing configurations across seemingly unrelated events? Do you synthesize information to pinpoint opportunities and issues? Do you tend to visualize new possibilities, challenge assumptions, and generate options to solve problems, seize opportunities?
  • Collaborative - Are you able to work with and through others to achieve results? Do you have the emotional intelligence to understand the needs and perspectives of others, share information, report back, and be a strong team player?
  • A decisive decision-maker – Are you able to analyze situations carefully, seek diverse perspectives, and make decisions that align with strategic goals and objectives?
  • Ethical - Can you work with and steward confidential information and data? (This role requires high integrity, good judgment, confidentiality, and ethical compliance)
  • A champion of diversity and inclusion - Are you committed to diversity and inclusion and understanding the issues and challenges faced by diverse groups?
  • An excellent communicator – Do you have outstanding interpersonal and communication skills?
  • Persuasive – Are you able to present concepts, ideas and proposals and close the deal?
  • Strategic thinker and doer – Are you an expert in developing and executing strategic plans?
  • Reliable – Do you demonstrate reliability, organizational skills, and accountability to meet and exceed project and funder deliverable requirements?
  • Passionately committed to lifelong learning - stay abreast on industry trends, seek out new perspectives, and invest in your own personal and professional growth.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a dynamic, mission-driven, entrepreneurial organization committed to advancing Canada's competitive advantage in the digital economy.
  • Lead high-impact programs that drive economic growth and shape the future of Canadian businesses.
  • Work in an agile, collaborative, innovative, and forward-thinking environment where we are always helping each other achieve collective goals.

Location

  • Remote - Vancouver

Term

  • Renewable 12 months term contract, with competitive salary, benefits, vacation, personal time and RRSP contribution.

Additional notes:

  • ICTC is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. If you require accommodation measures during any phase of the hiring process, please notify us as soon as possible. All information received in relation to accommodation requests will be kept confidential.

  

About ICTC

ICTC is a neutral, not-for-profit national centre of expertise with the mission of strengthening Canada's digital advantage in the global economy. For over 30 years, and with a team of 80+ experts, we have delivered forward-looking research, practical policy advice, and capacity building solutions for individuals and businesses. Our goal is to ensure that technology is utilized to drive economic growth and innovation, and that Canada's workforce remains competitive on a global scale.

  • OUR MISSION IS TO: Strengthen Canada’s digital advantage in a global economy

raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe Infrastructure is responsible for the reliability, scale, performance, and cost of Stripe's systems and the productivity and sentiment of Stripe's people.

You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including:

  • Core Infrastructure—We're the home for Stripe's critical tier0 infrastructure systems (Compute, Networking, DocumentDB, Distributed Caching and High assurance engineering). We build the foundational platform for Stripe products and services to allow them to operate at scale. We drive reliability, availability, efficiency, and scalability of these systems.
  • Developer Infrastructure—We're responsible for the productivity of all developers at Stripe. Ensure Stripe's engineers have a reliable, fast, and easy-to-use inner dev loop to maximize productivity while building everything from low-latency microservices to large-scale data pipelines and machine learning models.
  • Data Infrastructure—We're responsible for offering data serving infrastructure spanning across data warehouse analytics, streaming analytics, and search capabilities. The stack is supported by a collection of internally developed large-scale distributed services and several popular open-source technologies like Trino/Presto, Apache Pinot, Hive Metastore, ElasticSearch etc. The systems we own support all of the data serving needs of high-scale services and thousands of individual Stripes across the company.
  • Admin Platform—We empower Stripes to quickly build secure and delightful internal products in service of their users.
  • Service Platform—We enable engineering teams at Stripe to easily write and ship useful services that correctly, reliably, and efficiently leverage platform capabilities.
  • Developer Productivity AI—We're responsible for doubling Stripe's engineering velocity through effective use of LLMs. We own Minions, Stripe's one-shot, end-to-end coding agents.

Team matching—exact team matching for one of the subteams will begin during final stages. Please note we may also consider you for different orgs based on your experience, location, etc. Find more information on our team matching process here.

What you'll do

You'll work on projects that span technologies, systems, and processes where you'll design, build, test, and ship great code every day.

Responsibilities

  • Build a great customer experience for internal and external Stripe teams using our infrastructure
  • Participate in roadmap planning and prioritization
  • Deliver value through a strong collaborative approach with multiple customers and stakeholders across Stripe
  • Debug production issues across services and several levels of the stack

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Strong software engineering skills and a passion for one of the areas above
  • Ability to write high-quality code (in programming languages like Go, Java, C/C++ etc.)
  • 2–12+ years of professional hands-on software development experience, able to write well-factored algorithms and have experience with commonly used data structures and algorithms
  • Hands-on experience contributing to or building large-scale distributed systems
  • Strong collaboration skills, can work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success
  • Customer obsession, ability to articulate and represent customer experience in various forums to drive the right outcome
  • Have the ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience optimizing the end-to-end performance of distributed systems
  • Focus on the needs of our users, both internal and external
  • Hold yourself and others to a high bar when working with production

raw.description:
Senior Accountant – NetSuite, GAAP, Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Accountant to own core accounting operations, month-end close, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

This is a hands-on accounting role for someone who understands GAAP, accrual accounting, NetSuite, and full-cycle accounting and can maintain accurate, audit-ready financials while improving processes as the business grows.

You’ll work closely with finance leadership, FP&A, operations, and junior accounting team members.

What You’ll Own

Month-End Close & General Ledger

  • Lead monthly and quarterly close activities
  • Prepare and post journal entries for accruals, prepaids, payroll, depreciation, and intercompany transactions
  • Maintain trial balances, close checklists, and supporting schedules
  • Target month-end close completion within 5–7 business days

Reconciliations & Accounting Operations

  • Reconcile cash, AR, AP, deferred revenue, inventory, and fixed assets
  • Investigate discrepancies and resolve accounting issues
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready financial records
  • Ensure appropriate accounting treatment under U.S. GAAP

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements
  • Analyze budget vs. actual and forecast vs. actual performance
  • Investigate material variances and provide clear commentary

raw.excerpt: About AvaazAvaaz is an international campaigning and advocacy organisation that provides its global membership of almost 70 million people with opportunities to make our world a better place.
raw.description:
About Avaaz

Avaaz is an international campaigning and advocacy organisation that provides its global membership of almost 70 million people with opportunities to make our world a better place.

We’re one of the world’s largest online global campaigning movements, with people from every corner in the world taking action to close the gap between the world we have and the world most people everywhere want. This includes protecting human rights worldwide, supporting indigenous struggles, saving our planet from climate change and other threats, and fighting to stop disinformation and other cyber threats from undermining our democracies.

Our model enables people to channel their voices into a powerful collective force at tipping point moments to impact the pressing global challenges of our time, from climate and ecological collapse to human rights abuses and the dismantling of democracy.

Avaaz is funded through small donations from individual Avaaz members, no big money from governments or corporations. This keeps us independent and allows us to keep a laser focus on doing what the world needs.

Language Associate (Dutch) - Part-Time Position (Approx. 20 hours/week)

This is an exciting consultant position that offers a unique opportunity to support large-scale social change efforts. Language Associates bring Avaaz to millions of people each week by translating Avaaz campaigns from English into key languages and rewriting them to be fitting to local contexts. This role requires strong written communication skills and cultural awareness that allow you to capture the heart of Avaaz’ campaigns and powerfully translate them into Dutch language.

The successful candidate for this part-time position (20 hours/week) will work closely with the Dutch language lead and with the Member Engagement and Community Petitions teams, and they will report to an Avaaz staffer. Please note that this position is on a freelance/independent contractor basis.

Responsibilities

  • Translate Avaaz campaigns from English to Dutch to turn them into strong, emotive, and compelling campaigns to send out in The Netherlands and Belgium, and to Dutch-speaking members around the world.
  • Hands-on technical support for campaign development, including setting up email blasts and landing pages in the Avaaz website backend interface, and supporting the drafting and testing of campaigns.
  • Looking for sources for campaigns -- finding relevant, issue-specific, supporting materials from the press, NGOs, etc.
  • Monitor and enhance the Dutch Avaaz website and other tools for functionality and language errors, supporting clear and effective communication with members.
  • Support the Dutch campaign team to write and edit excellent campaign materials such as briefings, advocacy letters, and press releases. Translate and/or edit other materials as necessary: Media material, content for social media etc.
  • Reviewing, managing, and supporting the petitions published by Dutch members on the Avaaz Community Petitions website.

Qualifications

  • Excellent written and oral communication, and translation skills in Dutch, combined with creative thinking to craft engaging texts.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, the Avaaz team’s working language.
  • Professionalism, efficiency, and results-oriented delivery on short timelines.
  • Flexibility and ability to adapt to (somewhat) varying weekly workloads.
  • Passion and commitment to global justice, citizen empowerment, and social change.
  • Strong teamwork skills, comfortable in a highly collaborative culture, and a hierarchical team structure.
  • Proficient in Google Suite and online communication systems (Slack, Zoom, etc).
  • Ideally: cultural and linguistic understanding of regional differences (e.g. the Netherlands and Belgium), to guarantee Avaaz content can be understood across Dutch-speaking regions.

Compensation

This is an independent contractor role, paid at an hourly rate of €25,- depending on experience and location. Contractors are responsible for their own taxes and statutory contributions in their country of residence.

Location

Avaaz is a virtual organization, with most of our work done online. Our staff and contractors are based in locations all over the world. For this position, the candidate would ideally be based in the European/Middle East/African time zones.

Application Timeline

We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis, and encourage all candidates to submit applications as soon as possible.

Our Recruitment Process

Avaaz undertakes a comprehensive recruitment procedure designed to select the most talented candidate for any given position. The recruitment process is comprised of the following steps:

  1. Application Review
  2. Screening Call
  3. Written exercise
  4. Final Interview
  5. Offer Call

Avaaz’s Commitment to Equity and Inclusion

As a global organization with millions of members around the world, it’s important to us that our team reflects the diversity needed to lead a movement of people from across the planet, rising to meet some of the most complex challenges humanity has ever faced. We believe we can only succeed by building a diverse team full of fresh perspectives and original ideas, and we are committed to creating a working environment in which everyone has an equal opportunity to fulfill their potential.

Our team includes English as a first language, as well as second language speakers, the self-taught and university-educated, people with all sorts of professional backgrounds. If doing the job you just read about would make you excited to come to work every day, if you’re talented, hard-working, and committed to making a difference, we want you to apply.

Avaaz does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, colour, ancestry, language and accent, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, family/parental or marital status, political affiliation, religion, socioeconomic class, caste, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

We’ll provide reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities or special needs to participate in the application process, so please let us know if you have such a request when you apply.

Please do not send your application via email or LinkedIn. Only applications received via the form online on our website will be considered. Thank you!

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter (Global) to drive hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Infrastructure, and other technical functions globally.

This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will be responsible for attracting top technical talent, partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy, and helping build a high-performing Talent Acquisition function as the company continues to scale globally.

You will play a critical role in shaping BJAK’s technical workforce while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing best-in-class recruiting practices across the organization.


What You’ll Do

Technical Recruitment Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment process for technical positions across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, QA, and related functions.

  • Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring requirements, interview strategies, talent profiles, and workforce planning priorities.

  • Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, talent mapping, compensation insights, and hiring recommendations.

  • Drive recruitment outcomes for complex, senior, niche, and business-critical technical positions globally.

  • Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify and engage top passive talent across competitive international markets.

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

  • Build and maintain strong technical talent pipelines to support both immediate and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.

  • Stay current on technical hiring trends, market conditions, compensation benchmarks, and talent availability across key regions.

Team Development & Process Excellence

  • Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing capability, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management effectiveness.

  • Establish and continuously improve recruitment processes, sourcing methodologies, interview calibration standards, and hiring best practices.

  • Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Contribute to the growth and development of the global Talent Acquisition team as the organization scales.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.

  • Track key recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and hiring quality.

  • Ensure a positive, professional, and consistent candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

  • Support compliance with local hiring regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.


The Right Fit Has

  • 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, with significant exposure to technical hiring.

  • Proven track record recruiting for Software Engineering, Product Management, Data Science, AI/ML, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, or related technical functions.

  • Demonstrated success hiring senior and difficult-to-fill technical positions in competitive talent markets.

  • Strong sourcing expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, networking, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.

  • Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.

  • Strong understanding of technical talent markets, technical role requirements, and engineering organizational structures.

  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing hiring decisions through data, insights, and market expertise.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.

  • Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers high-quality technical hires across multiple functions and regions.

  • Builds strong, sustainable talent pipelines for critical technical roles.

  • Serves as a trusted hiring partner to technical leaders and executives.

  • Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.

  • Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.

  • Opportunity to build world-class technical teams globally.

  • Exposure to complex international hiring across multiple markets.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to the future of technology and AI-enabled products.

raw.description:
At Arctic Wolf, we're not just navigating the cybersecurity landscape - we're redefining it. Our global team of dedicated Pack members is driving innovation and setting new industry standards every day. Our impact speaks for itself: we've earned recognition on the Forbes Cloud 100, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fortune Future 50, and Fortune Cyber 60 lists, and we recently took home the 2024 CRN Products of the Year award. We’re proud to be named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape for Worldwide Managed Detection and Response Services and earning a Customers' Choice distinction from Gartner Peer Insights. Our Aurora Platform also received CRN’s Products of the Year award in the inaugural Security Operations Platform category. Join a company that’s not only leading, but also shaping, the future of security operations.

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Business Systems Manager to be a part of making this happen.

About the Role

The Business Systems Manager is an IT professional that partners closely with the Business Applications team, fellow NetSuite administrators, and key business stakeholders to ensure NetSuite is used effectively, consistently, and in alignment with shared enterprise standards.

With a strong focus on NetSuite as the core ERP, this role translates Finance, Procurement, Revenue and accounting requirements into scalable configurations, workflows, and user-friendly solutions that drive efficiency, control, and continuous improvement.

In addition, working knowledge of order to cash lifecycle and platforms such as NetSuite, Avalara, is essential, as the role serves as the functional and technical owner of multiple ecosystems, supporting end-to-end processes across Quote to cash, Procure to Pay, expense management and Revenue Recognition

Blending business acumen with systems expertise, the Business System Manager collaborates confidently with Business—from System Admins to Managers—to deliver platforms that operate as strategic assets rather than just supporting tools.

Responsibilities

System Administration & Configuration

  • Configure and maintain business systems based on user needs and operational requirements.

  • Serve as the business systems consultant, ensuring solutions align with business objectives and processes.

  • Recommend system configuration changes, enhancements, and process improvements to optimize business operations.

  • Develop deep expertise in assigned business applications and related business processes.

  • Administration experience including workflows, scripting, and day-to-day system support

  • Balance strategic objectives with tactical business needs when prioritizing system changes and enhancements.

Internal Team Partnership & Communication

  • Liaise with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and implementation partners to understand business requirements and translate them into system solutions.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for business system inquiries, guidance, and support.

  • Represent business stakeholders in discussions with other departments and technical teams regarding system enhancements and initiatives.

  • Provide regular project updates, status reporting, and risk communication to leadership and key stakeholders.

  • Foster strong partnerships across operational, technical, and leadership teams to ensure successful outcomes.

Change Execution & Documentation

  • Lead and coordinate business system change initiatives from planning through implementation.

  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and deliverables for medium-sized projects.

  • Create and maintain system documentation, process guides, release notes, and knowledge resources.

  • Execute change management activities to support user adoption of new processes and technologies.

  • Deliver training sessions and educational materials for end users impacted by system or process changes.

  • Collaborate with implementation partners and project teams during larger-scale initiatives.

Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide production support and troubleshooting for assigned business systems.

  • Identify, assess, and resolve system-related issues and operational roadblocks.

  • Escalate and coordinate issue resolution with technical teams, vendors, and leadership as required.

  • Monitor system performance and proactively recommend improvements to reduce operational inefficiencies.

  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT), validation activities, and post-deployment stabilization efforts.

Integrations & System Awareness

  • Build and maintain a strong understanding of integrations between assigned business applications and the broader technology ecosystem.

  • Assess the impact of system changes on downstream and upstream applications, processes, and data flows.

  • Collaborate with Business Intelligence and technical teams to ensure alignment between business systems, reporting, and analytics requirements.

  • Support integration planning, testing, and deployment activities to maintain system reliability and data integrity.

  • Identify opportunities to improve cross-platform efficiency and user experiences.

Access & Governance Support

  • Collaborate with Business Intelligence Architects, Directors, and other stakeholders on user access management and role-based security.

  • Support governance processes related to user provisioning, permissions, compliance, and system controls.

  • Participate in release management, production support, governance, and testing cycles.

  • Ensure business system configurations and processes adhered to organizational policies and standards.

  • Support audit, compliance, and documentation requirements related to system administration and access controls.

Functional Expertise

  • Strong understanding of Finance and Accounting business processes, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Intercompany Transactions, and Financial Close activities.

  • Working knowledge of Quote-to-Cash (QTC) processes, including customer onboarding, order management, billing, invoicing, collections, revenue recognition, and renewal workflows.

  • Working knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, including requisitions, purchase orders, approvals, vendor management, invoice processing, and payment execution.

  • Understanding of SaaS business models and associated systems requirements, including subscription billing, contract amendments, usage-based billing, revenue recognition, and customer lifecycle management.

  • Experience supporting financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and operational planning processes through integrated business systems.

  • Ability to translate accounting policies, operational requirements, and audit controls into scalable system configurations and business processes.

  • Strong understanding of financial controls, segregation of duties (SoD), SOX requirements, audit readiness, and governance processes within enterprise systems.

  • Experience defining business requirements, documenting current and future-state processes, performing gap analysis, and developing scalable solution designs.

  • Ability to partner effectively with Finance, Procurement, Revenue Operations, Tax, and Accounting stakeholders to drive process standardization and continuous improvement.

  • Understanding of enterprise data flows, master data management, and cross-functional dependencies across ERP, planning, tax, procurement, expense management, and reporting platforms.

  • Experience supporting testing strategies, user acceptance testing (UAT), release validation, and change management activities for business-critical financial systems.

  • Working knowledge of subscription-based revenue operations, including contract lifecycle management, recurring billing, usage-based pricing models, revenue compliance, and SaaS performance metrics.

Who You Are

  • Working knowledge of Corporate Business Systems (i.e., CRM, Marketing Automation, PRM, CMS, and ERP tools)

  • Understanding iPaaS solutions (e.g. Jitterbit, Boomi, etc.) and integration experience with internal applications (NetSuite, Adaptive, Pigment, Avalara, Workday, Navan, Zip etc.).

  • Working knowledge of Business Operations practices (i.e., Quote to Cash, Sales, and Marketing Demand Generation)

  • Ingenuity to find solutions that bridge the gap between system constraints and business need

  • Excellent analytical and abstract reasoning skills

  • Effective communicator with technical peers and non-technical stakeholders

  • Good foundational skills in project management

  • Aptitude for learning many areas of the business and ability to understand user requirements, and ability to bridge the gap between system constraints and business need

Minimum Qualifications​​

  • 3+ years of experience with Business Systems and Administration

  • Experience or familiarity with different Finance/Accounting platforms (e.g., NetSuite, Avalara, Coupa, Zip, Navan or similar).

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) for documentation, data analysis, and stakeholder communication.

  • Willingness to continue growing through experience and/or study and certification.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

  • SaaS / High Tech industry experience preferred

  • Cybersecurity industry experience preferred

  • Prior experience building and supporting a hyper-growth business in a distributed environment

  • NetSuite Suite Foundation Certification preferred

On-Camera Policy

  • To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews.

  • Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers.

  • We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

Our Values 

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.  

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

  • Equity for all employees

  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days

  • RRSP match

  • Training and career development programs

  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services

  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services

  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire employee experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodations by emailing . 

Security Requirements 

  • Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).

  • Background checks are required for this position.

  • This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these laws and regulations.

The base salary range for this job family is 60,000 to 181,000 CAD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is seeking a Sr. Data Scientist to join our team building the next generation of AI/ML technologies. You will work closely with other scientists, software engineers and product managers to provide technical leadership and strategic direction, while driving hands-on-keyboard innovation in our AI capabilities.

You will help shape the technical vision, collaborate with team members, and create impactful LLM-driven applications. This is a unique opportunity to lead groundbreaking developments in AI safety, AI red-teaming, and applied AI deployments that will revolutionize how we interact with AI systems safely. This opportunity is ideal for someone who likes to apply cutting-edge technologies to live cyber-relevant problem sets.

What You’ll Do:

  • Work alongside teammates to develop clever, innovative, and efficient solutions to problems in AI safety and cyber detection.

  • Co-develop strategies and implementations for end-to-end research and development: data sourcing, data labeling, advanced modeling, evaluation/benchmarking, and product-ready engineering collaboration.

  • Interoperate with product and engineering teams to ensure that you are designing and building the right solutions: fit-for-purpose, efficient, computable, and maintainable.

  • Drive innovation in LLM-related research and development in close collaboration with security experts.

raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

Newsweek is seeking a Foreign Editor to lead international news and foreign affairs coverage from our UK-based digital newsroom, targeting a U.S. audience.

This role is responsible for ensuring Newsweek's global coverage is driven not simply by what is happening around the world, but by what matters most to American readers. The successful candidate will shape coverage of global events through a distinctly American lens, identifying and developing stories that connect international developments to U.S. interests, politics, security, business and culture. They will help audiences understand how events abroad affect America and its place in the world, delivering journalism that is authoritative, insightful and relevant to the lives and concerns of our readers.

Reporting to the News Director, London Bureau, this senior leadership role combines people management, editorial strategy, commissioning and hands-on editing to deliver high-impact journalism that distinguishes Newsweek from competitors.

The Foreign Editor will lead a team comprising reporters based in London and New York. They will be responsible for setting clear editorial priorities, coaching reporters to improve performance, developing talent and ensuring the team consistently meets ambitious production, audience and quality targets.

The successful candidate will use audience insights, reporting expertise and strong editorial judgement to identify opportunities for original journalism, exclusives, interviews and enterprise reporting. They will challenge and support reporters to develop distinctive angles on global news stories, ensuring Newsweek delivers coverage that is authoritative, insightful and differentiated in a highly competitive news environment.

The Foreign Editor will embrace the opportunities presented by AI and automation technologies while maintaining the highest editorial, legal and ethical standards. They will be agile and innovative, continuously seeking new ways to improve newsroom performance, grow audiences, and enhance the quality of Newsweek's journalism.

They will be responsible for ensuring high-quality coverage that is accurate, fair, and conforms to accepted standards of journalism. They will also perform any other reasonable duties necessary to meet the needs of the business.

This is a full-time role working 5 days a week. Weekendshifts will be required on a rotational basis. Working times on weekdays are typically 7am to 4pm and on weekends 8am to 5pm.

You may work from home anywhere in the UK or from our London, Canary Wharf office.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead, mentor and develop a team of reporters and editors, providing regular coaching, feedback and performance management to improve output, quality and audience engagement.
  • Set clear editorial objectives and hold team members accountable for meeting agreed production, audience and performance targets.
  • Commission, edit and publish high-impact coverage of international news, geopolitics and national security.
  • Drive original reporting, exclusives, interviews and enterprise journalism that differentiates Newsweek from competitors.
  • Use audience data, analytics and market intelligence to inform coverage decisions and identify growth opportunities.
  • Ensure reporters consistently identify distinctive angles, sources and story opportunities that strengthen Newsweek's brand and authority.
  • Respond rapidly to breaking news and oversee major coverage plans, including live blogs and rolling news operations.
  • Collaborate closely with the News Director and senior editors on editorial strategy, newsroom planning and special projects.
  • Use AI and automation tools responsibly to improve newsroom efficiency and editorial performance.
  • Monitor global developments, emerging trends and audience interests to shape daily and long-term coverage priorities.
  • Maintain the highest standards of accuracy, fairness, legal compliance and journalistic integrity.
  • Lead the news operation on weekdays and weekends when required.
  • Ensure Newsweek delivers high-quality reporting that is accurate, fair, and conforms to accepted standards of journalism.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties as necessary to meet the needs of the business.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

  • Extensive editing and reporting experience at a reputable publication, with significant expertise in international news, geopolitics, foreign affairs or national security.
  • Proven experience managing journalists, including coaching reporters, developing talent and driving measurable improvements in performance.
  • Demonstrable track record of delivering audience growth and using analytics to inform editorial decision-making.
  • Strong record of commissioning and producing original reporting, exclusives, investigations and interview-led journalism.
  • Exceptional news judgement and ability to identify distinctive, audience-focused angles on major global stories.
  • Ability to lead teams in a fast-paced digital newsroom and make effective decisions under pressure.
  • Experience setting objectives, managing performance and holding staff accountable for agreed targets and standards.
  • Proficiency and willingness to work with AI tools and integrate them responsibly into editorial workflows.
  • Strong command of digital publishing platforms, CMS tools, analytics systems and newsroom technology.
  • Excellent understanding of media law, editorial risk and journalistic best practice.
  • Outstanding communication, leadership and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends on a rotational basis.

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

About the Role

As a Veterinary Account Manager, you're the one person at Roo your vets know by name: the first call when something's wrong, the advocate in the room when decisions affect them, and the reason they keep choosing Roo. You'll spot risks before they become churn and directly grow the revenue line the company watches most.

The role blends genuine relationship building with a data-informed operating rhythm. You'll work from booking data, engagement signals, and CRM insights to know each vet's story, catch changes early, and decide where your week goes. You'll also represent Roo in person through vet events, community programming, and conference presence.
