raw.description:
Overview

The American Association for Cancer Research (AACR), with more than 61,000 laboratory, translational, and clinical researchers; population scientists; other health care professionals; and patient advocates residing in 143 countries and territories around the world, is the first and largest organization in the world dedicated to advances in all areas of high-quality, innovative cancer research. Its mission is to prevent and cure all cancers. The programs and activities of the AACR foster the exchange of new knowledge among scientists and physicians in cancer research as well as in related sciences. The AACR publishes ten peer-reviewed scientific journals and an award-winning magazine for cancer patients and their loved ones; convenes topical scientific conferences and an annual meeting that draws more than 22,500 participants; offers educational workshops that train young investigators in a variety of scientific and clinical areas; funds research fellowships, career development awards, and research grants for both senior and junior investigators; raises public awareness of the progress in the biology, detection, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of cancer; engages actively in advocacy for increased federal research funding and other national policies that accelerate progress against cancer; and interacts with regulatory agencies to support regulatory science and policy. Learn more at www.aacr.org.

About the Project

AACR Project Genomics, Evidence, Neoplasia, Information, Exchange (GENIE) is a publicly accessible international cancer registry of real-world clinico-genomic data assembled through data sharing between 20 of the leading cancer centers in the world. Through the efforts of strategic partners Sage Bionetworks and cBioPortal, the registry aggregates, harmonizes, and links clinical-grade, next-generation cancer genomic sequencing data with clinical outcomes obtained during routine medical practice from cancer patients treated at these institutions.

Job Summary:

AACR Project GENIE® is seeking an experienced Senior Biostatistician to provide statistical leadership across an international real-world clinico-genomic data consortium. This individual will serve as the primary statistical resource for the project, partnering with clinicians, scientists, data managers, and external collaborators to design, execute, and interpret observational research studies using real-world oncology data.

The successful candidate will independently develop statistical analysis plans, contribute to study protocols and publications, design appropriate analytical methodologies, and perform statistical programming in R. This role requires expertise in real-world data, including electronic health records, cancer registries, genomic sequencing data, and longitudinal clinical outcomes, as well as the ability to translate scientific questions into rigorous and reproducible statistical analyses.

This role is ideal for a senior biostatistician who enjoys working independently and leading the statistical design, programming, and interpretation of multiple concurrent studies within a collaborative multidisciplinary environment. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who takes initiative and balances big picture strategy with execution against project goals, bringing an entrepreneurial, visionary approach and the ability to conceive of, execute, and communicate innovative solutions. Additionally, the successful candidate should bring a strong passion for mission-driven causes and a commitment to advancing cancer research through high-quality, collaborative, statistical science.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the statistical subject matter expert for AACR Project GENIE, providing consultation to investigators, collaborators, and project leadership on study design and analytical strategy.
  • Collaborate with investigators, pharmaceutical clients, and academic institutions to design observational studies using real-world clinico-genomic data
  • Develop statistical analysis plans (SAPs), define study populations, cohorts, endpoints, and analytical methods
  • Contribute statistical expertise to research protocols, study design, and publication planning
  • Perform statistical programming and analyses using R
  • Interpret results and contribute to manuscripts, abstracts, presentations and consortium reports
  • Willing to experiment with new analytic methods as needed.
  • Advise project leadership on appropriate statistical methodologies, and study design
  • Ensure analyses are reproducible, well documented, and adhere to best practices
  • Collaborate with data managers, investigators, and pharmaceutical clients to assess data quality, completeness and fitness for analysis
  • Independently lead the statistical aspects of multiple concurrent observational research studies from study conception through analysis and publication
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Education:

M.S. or Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of post-graduate experience providing end-to-end statistical support for observational research studies using real-world data (RWD), including electronic health records (EHRs), cancer registries, genomic data, claims data, or other longitudinal clinical data sources.
  • Demonstrated experience designing statistical analysis plans (SAPs), contributing statistical sections of research protocols, defining study cohorts, endpoints, and analytical methodologies for observational clinical research.
  • Prior peer-reviewed publications as a statistical collaborator
  • Strong proficiency in R is required, including statistical programming, data manipulation, reproducible workflows, and production-quality analytical code.
  • Experience applying statistical methods commonly used in oncology and observational research, including survival analysis, Kaplan-Meier estimation, competing risks, longitudinal analyses, regression modeling, propensity score methods, missing data approaches, and sensitivity analyses.
  • Experience collaborating with clinicians, scientific investigators, and data management teams to translate research questions into statistically rigorous study designs, with well-honed relationship building skills and outstanding, articulate, and persuasive communication, public speaking, and presentation abilities.
  • Experience interpreting and communicating statistical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, with exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities and a proven track record of success in solving complex and dynamic situations.
  • Entrepreneurial, visionary approach with the ability to conceive of, execute, and communicate innovative solutions.
  • Must be a self-starter who takes initiative and can balance big picture strategy and execution against goals.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Python proficiency
  • Experience working with clinico-genomic oncology datasets
  • Familiarity with REDCap or other EDC platforms
  • Experience with Git/GitHub strongly preferred

As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors.

What's in Store
We are on the lookout for a Training Specialist who will be responsible for developing the knowledge and skills of our independent contractors and staff. As the Training Specialist, you will assist with new hire orientation, continued development, and provide education and support to both field personnel and internal staff. The Training Specialist will track the progress of individuals through offered programs to ensure all business goals and objectives are achieved. This dynamic, high-visibility role will provide support to various departments by means of video calls, phone calls and email. This individual must maintain strong industry knowledge and keep pace with changes in program material, department processes and goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor training operations to identify opportunities to expand service offerings and/or improve processes via identification of best practices
  • Regularly report progress against established goals. Adjust goals and communicate new goals as circumstances require
  • Coach and mentor field personnel and internal staff
  • Provide feedback regarding training material to Training Manager
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training material
  • Ensure the onboarding and training of new field representatives and internal personnel in a timely manner
  • Maintain strong communications with the other departments
This is a full-time, remote position.

Skills, knowledge & expertise

  • Bachelors’ degree in related field OR equivalent work experience in Personal and Commercial Lines Insurance
  • Three years of experience in the insurance inspection industry or a related field is preferred (significant relevant experience can substitute for the education/specific industry requirement)

  • Leadership/Training Development: Confident, inspires and motivates others, influences effectively, accepts and gives feedback, recognizes others' contributions

  • Superb oral and written communication skills
  • Possess the ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Equal Employment Opportunity & Legal Notices

Davies is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces a wide range of perspectives and experiences. We believe that diversity of thought is essential for innovation and creativity, and we actively promote an environment where all voices are valued and heard.

raw.excerpt: OverviewFounded in 1898 and headquartered in Chicago, IL, GATX Corporation (NYSE: GATX) is an industry leader with 125+ years of success—success that is powered by our people.
raw.description:
Overview

Founded in 1898 and headquartered in Chicago, IL, GATX Corporation (NYSE: GATX) is an industry leader with 125+ years of success—success that is powered by our people. We are proud of our high-performance culture, hard-working and enthusiastic management team, and beautiful office space in the Willis Tower.

At GATX, we hire the best and offer our employees a dynamic, energetic, collaborative environment to enable them to make an impact from day one. Enjoy the perks and benefits of a global company with the close-knit culture and community of a much smaller one. In the same way we strive to empower our customers to propel the world forward, we are dedicated to providing our people with the tools and resources they need to advance in their careers.

The Sr. Collection Specialist is responsible for managing and collecting receivables for a portfolio of customers in North America. Responsibilities encompass calling customers, researching billing and cash application issues, and performing customer account reconciliations.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor customer balances using accounts receivable and cash receipt reporting to identify and prioritize balances in need of collection action.
    • Maintain accurate and thorough records of collection activities (a log/tracker with detailed notes on communications with customers and internal business partners, dates, and action items)
  • Contact customers (via phone and email), applying timely, diligently, and appropriate collection efforts to address balances past due.
    • This customer portfolio often requires more diligent investigation and troubleshooting (meetings w/ customer and internal partners) to resolve issues.
  • Identify and resolve past due balances and short payments by researching billing, cash application and adjustments utilizing various contacts at the customer’s organization and within GATX. Own the entire process to bring the matter to resolution.
    • Perform all necessary follow-up to ensure actions are taken by the responsible parties
    • Escalate accounts to appropriate parties when collection efforts stall
    • Monitor and resolve kick-outs (differences between payments and invoices) on a daily basis
    • Pinpoint issues and work proactively to address them before accounts become past due (PO accuracy, appropriate contacts, etc.)
  • Communicate account status to management timely and accurately in format and level of detail required
    • Prepare account status/summary for weekly meetings with manager
    • Prepare account status/summary for monthly review meetings with leadership
    • Prepare account status/summary for ad hoc review meetings with business partners
    • Respond to inquiries/requests for account details from business partners and customers timely
  • Prepare documentation and process routine transactions for customer portfolio
    • Customer refunds
    • Customer write-offs
    • Customer summary for accounts escalated to the legal team
    • Customer adjustments
  • Perform other projects or duties as assigned by the Manager/Director

Qualifications

  • Some college and/or work experience of 3-5 years in credit/collection and/or customer service fields. Knowledge and understanding of rail billing process is extremely helpful.
  • Proficiency and/or work experience in collections.
  • SAP experience is extremely helpful.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is essential for managing data, creating reports, using basic formulas and VLOOKUPS.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in collections.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively resolve any issues related to collections.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to effectively address any discrepancies or issues.
  • Typical knowledge of other Microsoft applications such as Outlook, Word, Teams and other Microsoft Office products.

This is a remote position; however, candidates must be based in the Chicago area to attend initial training and occasional in‑office meetings.

Posting Duration

This posting will remain open until the role is filled.As of the post date, the salary range for this position is:

Min

USD $70,300.00/Yr.

Max

USD $86,000.00/Yr.This role may be eligible to participate in the Company’s short-term incentive plan and long-term incentive plan, the details of which will be provided to the applicant upon hire.This range is a reasonable estimate and takes into account several factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including, but not limited to, geographic location, skill set, experience, education, training, internal equity, and other business needs.

About Us
Join Hypersonix, the premier AI-driven platform revolutionizing eCommerce and retail profitability. In an industry where 70% of businesses struggle with stagnation, escalating costs, and unpredictable risks, Hypersonix provides real-time, actionable intelligence powered by its proprietary Commerce Large Language Model.
We equip businesses with AI-driven insights to optimize sales, competition analysis, and demand forecasting—seamlessly integrating with major eCommerce, ERP, and financial platforms. Hypersonix enables businesses to identify risks and opportunities faster, ensuring sustainable, profitable growth. Our mission? To help retailers not just survive but thrive.
Be part of a team that’s reshaping the future of commerce with cutting-edge AI. Join us and make an impact!

Job Description
This position is responsible for the creation of new Hypersonix customers and establishing positive relationships with potential customers to achieve sales targets. The job includes active sales prospecting/hunting, lead cultivation, qualifying prospective new clients, arranging for software demonstrations to validate our fit, and coordinating with other experts on the team including product specialists, and management to win business.
Primarily an inside sales role, this position plays a critical part in expanding Hypersonix’s market presence, particularly among medium and large-sized businesses (SMBs) within our target industries, including retail, restaurants, eCommerce, and hospitality.

Your Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify, prospect, and qualify new business opportunities to drive sales growth.
  • Represent Hypersonix’s products and services, leveraging in-depth knowledge and market insights to demonstrate how our solutions address customer needs.
  • Refine and optimize the company’s lead-generation strategies by identifying best practices.
  • Implement annual sales and client account plans to meet revenue and relationship goals, as guided by the VP of Sales.
  • Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with key customers to drive new and ongoing business opportunities.
  • Stay informed on market trends, competitor activities, and customer challenges, providing strategic recommendations based on industry insights.
  • Accurately manage customer records, sales forecasts, expense plans, budgets, and other relevant data.
  • Develop and review sales proposals, ROI analyses, professional service estimates, and invoices.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Development and Finance, to ensure both customer and company objectives are met.
  • Effectively utilize a sales development platform to execute outreach through calls, emails, and social engagement.
What we're looking for
  • Proven sales experience in the retail, restaurant, hospitality, and eCommerce industries.
  • A strong track record of success in software or SaaS sales.
  • Highly motivated, persistent, and goal-driven in acquiring and closing targeted clients.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or other CRM platforms.
  • Ability to independently drive strategic sales opportunities and contribute to business growth.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and Microsoft Office is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) or at least 5+ years of relevant experience.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
  • This will be a remote job

The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.
We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.
Protective is seeking a motivated and analytical Actuarial Assistant or Actuarial Assistant II to join our Universal Life (UL) Valuation Team. As a member of Protective's Actuarial Student Program, you will gain valuable hands-on experience while receiving support for actuarial exam progression and professional development. This role offers the opportunity to partner with valuation actuaries, financial reporting professionals, and cross-functional business teams to support the accurate valuation and financial reporting of Universal Life products.
In this role, you will gain exposure to Statutory, GAAP, and Tax valuation processes, actuarial modeling, financial reporting, reserve analysis, and regulatory reporting. You will contribute to quarterly valuation activities, model enhancements, process improvement initiatives, and the implementation of new products and reporting capabilities. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals interested in developing expertise in life insurance valuation and financial reporting while progressing toward actuarial credentials.
The level and title will be determined based on the selected candidate's actuarial experience, exam progress, and demonstrated capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support quarterly valuation and financial reporting processes for Universal Life products.
  • Prepare and analyze Statutory, GAAP, and Tax reserves and related financial results.
  • Analyze period-over-period financial results, explain key drivers, and document findings.
  • Maintain, test, and enhance valuation models and supporting processes.
  • Assess the impact of model, assumption, and methodology updates on financial results.
  • Support actuarial testing, regulatory reporting, and governance activities.
  • Develop analytical tools, reporting solutions, and process automation initiatives to improve efficiency.
  • Provide valuation support for new products, product enhancements, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare reports, exhibits, and documentation to effectively communicate results and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Financial Reporting, Pricing, Modeling, and other actuarial teams to support business objectives.

Core Competencies (skills, knowledge and abilities):

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with databases and SQL or similar query technologies.
  • Programming experience or aptitude with VBA, Python, PowerShell, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with actuarial modeling systems; experience with PolySystems is a plus.
  • Knowledge of life insurance valuation concepts and financial reporting frameworks.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Power Query, or similar data visualization and reporting tools is a plus.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and desire to understand the drivers of financial performance.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of two actuarial exams completed.
  • Commitment to continued actuarial exam progress.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Interest in life insurance valuation, financial reporting, and actuarial modeling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Four or more actuarial exams completed.
  • Significant progress toward Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) designation.
  • Actuarial experience in valuation, financial reporting, modeling, pricing, or related analytical functions.
  • Experience in the insurance or financial services industry.
  • Experience with PolySystems or other actuarial modeling platforms.
  • Exposure to Statutory, GAAP, and Tax valuation methodologies.

Actuarial Student Program Benefits

    Protective is committed to supporting actuarial students throughout their credentialing journey. Participants in our Actuarial Student Program receive:
  • Company-sponsored study time for actuarial exams and modules.
  • Reimbursement for approved exam fees, study materials, and select preparation seminars.
  • Competitive exam-based salary increase opportunities.
  • Mentorship and career guidance from experienced actuarial leaders.
  • Rotational development opportunities designed to provide broad actuarial and business experience.
  • Paid membership dues for key actuarial professional organizations.
The internal job title for this position will be Actuarial Assistant or Actuarial Assistant II.
Employee Benefits:
We aim to protect the wellbeing of our employees and their families with a broad benefits offering. In addition to offering comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, we support emotional wellbeing through mental health benefits and an employee assistance program. Work/life balance is important and Protective offers a variety of paid time away benefits (e.g., paid time off, paid parental leave, short-term disability, and a cultural observance day). The financial health of our employees is just as important as physical and emotional health. Some of the financial wellbeing benefits include contributions to healthcare accounts, a pension plan, and a 401(k) plan with Company matching. All employees are encouraged to protect their overall wellbeing by engaging in ProHealth Rewards, Protective’s platform to improve wellbeing while earning cash rewards.

About the Company

Connor Consulting Partners, LLC is a specialist advisory firm delivering software license compliance and advisory services to a global client base.

We are in an exciting period of growth and organisational maturity. Our line of business is structured so that every person operates at their highest value: Directors focus on client outcomes and commercial growth, a dedicated delivery management function provides the operational infrastructure, and Account Managers and Technical Leads run day-to-day execution with genuine autonomy. The result is a firm where the delivery engine is as strong as the commercial engine.

The Opportunity

Connor Consulting is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist to create the written and visual assets that help our business development and sales teams win new work. In this role, you will be the connective tissue between our subject matter experts, marketing, and pursuit teams - translating complex consulting capabilities into compelling sales collateral, proposals, and RFx responses that move opportunities forward. You will own a content library that the sales team relies on every day and play a central role in producing high-quality, on-deadline responses to client RFPs and RFIs.

Key Accountabilities

Sales Content Development and Management

  • Write, design, and maintain a library of sales-facing content including pitch decks, capability overviews, one-pagers, case studies, service descriptions, and email templates.
  • Partner with subject matter experts and practice leaders to develop original thought leadership and client-ready narratives that differentiate Connor Consulting in the market.
  • Refresh and tailor existing collateral for specific industries, buyer personas, and stages of the sales cycle.
  • Maintain version control, taxonomy, and discoverability of content within the sales enablement library so the team can find what they need quickly.

RFP and Proposal Response Execution

  • Lead end-to-end development of responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs - coordinating contributors, owning the writing, and producing a polished, on-brand final deliverable.
  • Build and maintain a curated answer library of approved RFx responses, boilerplate language, bios, and qualifications so future proposals can be assembled faster and more consistently.
  • Drive the RFx process: kickoff meetings, content assignments, internal reviews, compliance checks against the RFx requirements, and final production.
  • Continuously improve win-themes, executive summaries, and proposal templates based on feedback from sales, clients, and pursuit debriefs.

Collaboration and Enablement

  • Work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, delivery, and leadership to surface new content needs and prioritize the development backlog.
  • Train the sales team on how to use new content, position key messages, and tailor materials for their conversations.
  • Track content usage and proposal outcomes; use that data to refine what we produce and how we deploy it.
  • Opportunity Management & Sales Support
  • Marketing & Campaign Support

Qualifications

Required

  • 3-5 years of experience in sales enablement, proposal writing, marketing content, or a closely related role—ideally within professional services, consulting, or B2B.
  • Demonstrated experience writing and managing RFP, RFI, or proposal responses from kickoff through final submission.
  • Exceptional business writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate technical or complex subject matter into clear, persuasive prose.
  • Strong project management instincts: comfortable juggling multiple deadlines, coordinating contributors, and driving work forward without constant oversight.
  • Proficiency with standard sales enablement and productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, HubSpot or comparable CRM, SharePoint, content management platforms).
  • Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting a consulting or professional services sales team.
  • Familiarity with proposal management software
  • Design sensibility and comfort polishing PowerPoint and Word templates so deliverables look as good as they read.
  • Experience using analytics or content scorecards to measure what's working and inform iteration.

What You'll Bring

  • A writer's eye and an editor's discipline - you sweat the details on tone, accuracy, and consistency.
  • A bias toward structure and reusability: you build assets once and design them so the team can adapt them again and again.
  • Comfort working with senior stakeholders, asking sharp questions, and synthesizing their input into a single coherent voice.
  • Grace under deadline pressure - RFPs land when they land, and you keep the team on track.

Benefits - Why Connor?

We approach every relationship with purpose, attention, and a little fun! You can expect a flexible working environment, paid mental health days, a generous vacation package, and competitive compensation. You’ll be working with a highly driven, collaborative global team that values trust, accountability, and continuous learning. We nurture our people in a culture that promotes diversity and individuality that sparks innovation and creativity.

Connor Consulting Partners, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity, equality, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you are a professional who is looking for an opportunity where you can put your honed skills and abilities to work for a mission that you are passionate about, then this is the right career opportunity for you.

Join us and be part of our Global Team. Apply now!

ABOUT NATERA

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our mission is to change the management of disease worldwide with a focus on continuous innovation. Natera's proprietary genetic testing technologies are transforming clinical decision-making across four key divisions:

  • Women's Health — Non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT) and carrier screening used by millions worldwide
  • Oncology — Signatera™ molecular residual disease (MRD) testing to detect and monitor cancer recurrence
  • Organ Health — Prospera™ transplant assessment to detect rejection earlier and improve outcomes
  • Rare Disease — Genetic diagnostics to identify hereditary conditions impacting patients and families

Headquartered in Austin, TX, Natera operates CLIA-certified laboratories and partners with leading healthcare systems, pharmaceutical companies, and research institutions. We are a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: NTRA) committed to scientific rigor, operational excellence, and improving patient lives through data-driven medicine.

POSITION SUMMARY

This is a temporary position created to provide maternity leave coverage, with an anticipated duration aligned to the leave period. The selected candidate will be fully embedded in Natera's Finance organization and is expected to operate independently and at full capacity from day one.

The Senior Financial Analyst supports the organization by delivering timely, accurate, and insightful business expense performance analyses to management. This role gathers, analyzes, prepares, and summarizes recommendations for financial plans, future requirements, and operating forecasts. The Senior Financial Analyst develops, interprets, and implements financial concepts for financial planning and control while performing technical analyses to determine present and future financial performance.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Monitor, identify, and communicate financial expense performance to business partners
  • Review and approve expense requisitions, highlighting items outside of budget parameters
  • Develop departmental financial and project expense benchmarks and reporting
  • Create ad-hoc analyses and business forecasts
  • Support accounting close process and audit reporting
  • Design and implement scalable processes and procedures to report key business metrics
  • Identify and drive implementation of cost reduction and process improvement projects
  • Work with all functional groups to meet financial and corporate goals
  • Handle Protected Health Information (PHI) — both paper and electronic — in compliance with HIPAA and Natera policy
  • Complete required HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance, and security training within the first 30 days of hire
  • Maintain current status on all Natera training requirements

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting
  • Advanced Excel proficiency — pivot tables, VBA macros (build from scratch), and Lookup functions
  • Strong financial systems and business application skills, including database applications (QlikView preferred)
  • Working knowledge of GAAP

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Strong analytical skills with a focus on solving moderate to complex financial issues
  • Experience supporting an R&D or Engineering organization is preferred
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Self-starter with the ability to thrive in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple time-sensitive projects, interdependencies, and potential risks
  • Sound judgment and discretion in handling sensitive information within defined policies and practices
  • Collaborative work style, strong service orientation, and the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

Company Summary

Learning Network is a growing, innovative, and customer-centric educational services company. We seek creative and tenacious individuals to help us drive success through service.

Service is very important to us. At Learning Network, you will be among people who care about their customers and colleagues. We prioritize service by ensuring the details are done and done well - every time. We make promises, and we keep those promises. We recognize that our customers and employees don’t have to choose us. As such, service is embedded deep within our culture - and providing white-glove service is an expectation of every employee.

At Learning Network, you’ll be a part of something special. You’ll sleep better knowing you make a difference by bringing the most innovative education to thousands of students. You’ll do this amongst a supportive community of people who care. In return, you’ll care. You’ll show you care by being teachable, doing your job well, and valuing the relationships with your colleagues. You’ll achieve your goals and play nicely in the sandbox with others while doing it. We don’t do drama, and neither should you.

Working at Learning Network isn’t for everyone. But for those who choose to commit to hard work, service, students, and colleagues, it’s an incredibly rewarding experience.

Impact & Why This Matters

In a world where too many students feel unseen, disconnected, or left behind—whether due to distance, circumstance, or doubt—you will be their consistent champion.

Every proactive outreach, personalized video feedback, and timely intervention has the power to restore belief, spark 'I can do this' moments, accelerate mastery, and set a young person on a trajectory toward post-high school success, meaningful careers, and purposeful lives—whether through college, skilled trades, certifications, apprenticeships, entrepreneurship, or other paths that align with their unique strengths and dreams.

This isn’t routine teaching. It's legacy-building in the digital age: redefining what’s possible in education by delivering white-glove, heart-centered support that reaches students anywhere and empowers them to own their futures—one empowered learner at a time.

Purpose

You will be the daily force that ignites curiosity, rebuilds confidence, and unlocks lifelong potential in every student. You will find ways to open doors for students. You will champion personalized success through relentless engagement, clear guidance, and unwavering belief—delivering transformative, white-glove service that changes trajectories for students and families alike.

Role Overview

This is a deeply student-facing, relationship-driven role where your impact hinges on daily human connection. You'll reach out consistently via phone, text, chat, Zoom, and email while guiding learners through a powerful, structured curriculum.

Your success is measured in both key performance indicators like engagement rates and on-pace progress and in lives changed: students who re-engage after setbacks, gain confidence through meaningful feedback, stay on pace toward graduation, and emerge more resilient and capable.

It demands extreme ownership, lightning responsiveness, and joyful persistence because when you show up fully, students feel seen, valued, and unstoppable.

Core Responsibilities

  • Build unbreakable daily connections that keep students motivated, seen, and soaring, turning potential drop-offs into breakthroughs through caring, proactive outreach.
  • Guide learners through the curriculum with clarity and passion, reinforcing key concepts and helping them master material.
  • Monitor engagement and progress with eagle-eyed attention; spot struggling or disengaged students early and launch timely, personalized interventions that reignite momentum.
  • Deliver timely grading and powerful, meaningful feedback that reinforces learning, celebrates growth, builds self-efficacy, and equips students to conquer challenges with confidence.

Essential Duties

  1. Serve students, families, and colleagues with genuine professionalism, integrity, humility, and a white-glove mindset that makes every interaction feel personal and uplifting.
  2. Own daily monitoring of student engagement and academic progress; act swiftly and thoughtfully when support is needed most.
  3. Foster genuine relationships through consistent, reliable, multi-channel communication that makes students and families feel supported all day, every school day.
  4. Empower mastery of course material by guiding students with clarity, varied explanations, and encouragement that sparks deeper understanding.
  5. Provide prompt, high-quality grading and feedback that inspires forward movement and long-term growth.
  6. Keep precise, actionable records of progress and interventions to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  7. Collaborate enthusiastically with peers and leaders to amplify student success across the team.
  8. Engage fully in professional development, meetings, and training to continuously elevate your impact.
  9. Teach faithfully within the assigned curriculum, pacing, and resources only, channeling your creativity into masterful delivery rather than any creation from scratch or use of outside materials.
  10. Lead live sessions when called upon, bringing energy and connection using only provided content.
  11. Support proctoring during testing windows, including occasional travel, to ensure fair and secure assessments.
  12. Embrace other duties as needed to advance our mission.

Work Schedule and Availability

  1. Work a fixed schedule: 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Mountain Time (Denver/America), year-round, auto-adjusting for daylight saving time.
  2. Work full time in this exempt role, requiring at least 40 hours per week with uninterrupted focus during scheduled hours.
  3. Remain actively available and immediately responsive throughout the workday via phone, chat, Zoom, email, and internal systems so students, parents, and colleagues can reach you in real time.
  4. Avoid all concurrent work during scheduled hours and maintain full professional focus; ensure any outside employment does not interfere with performance and is approved in writing in advance.
  5. Maintain a private, professional, distraction-free remote workspace with reliable high-speed internet that supports video and required tools.
  6. Maintain consistent daily availability; absences exceeding two consecutive instructional days materially disrupt student support, engagement, and progress monitoring and generally cannot be accommodated during the instructional term.

This Role Is Your Calling If:

  • You wake up energized by the chance to be a consistent, believing adult in a student's life—especially when the world feels overwhelming.
  • You thrive on forging real relationships that spark "aha" moments, rebuild confidence, and drive lasting growth.
  • You're wired for excellence: self-driven, ultra-responsive, and proud to own every student's progress as if it were your own family member.
  • You see online education as a superpower—reaching underserved students anywhere, personalizing at scale, and redefining access to transformative learning.
  • You embrace clear structure, metrics, and accountability because they fuel your ability to deliver extraordinary results.

This Role May Not Align If:

  • You seek high flexibility in your schedule or a self-paced workday.
  • You prefer minimal direct interaction with students or parents.
  • You dislike proactive outreach such as phone calls or frequent messaging.
  • You expect primarily asynchronous teaching with limited real-time engagement.
  • You struggle with tight responsiveness, follow-through, or time management under metrics.
  • You want to balance this position with another job.
  • You resist oversight, performance tracking, or structured expectations.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  1. Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly, empathetically, and professionally.
  2. Ability to build rapport, gain commitment, and explain concepts using varied methods.
  3. Extreme ownership of outcomes with high self-motivation, discipline, and accountability to exceed expectations.
  4. Proven content knowledge and prior educational success with students from a variety of backgrounds.
  5. Strong organizational skills, time management, attention to detail, and the ability to handle competing priorities.
  6. Independent work capability paired with effective remote team collaboration.
  7. Proficiency with Mac OS, Google Workspace, learning management systems, and task tools (e.g., Asana); quick adaptation to new technologies.
  8. Willingness and ability to travel to assigned testing locations for proctoring.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education or related field (required)
  • Teacher certification and an approved teacher preparation program (required)
  • Ability to obtain certifications in Arizona, Colorado, Washington, and other states as may be assigned (required)
  • 3+ years teaching experience (preferred)
  • 2+ years online teaching experience (preferred)
  • Ability to pass required background checks (required)

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision employee coverage for as little as $1 each per month;
  • Personal paid time off in addition to major holidays;
  • Short-term disability insurance, long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and AD&D insurance are all 100% paid by the employer; and
  • 401(k) with employer contributing a dollar-for-dollar match of employee contributions up to 6% of employee earnings.
Base Pay Range
$50,000—$55,000 USD

raw.description:
This job is what Jerry is all about: helping our customers take care of their most important assets, their car and home, with the kind of warmth and speed they didn't expect from an insurance company.

Car and home are people’s most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - insurance, repairs, financing, maintenance - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry.ai is building the first app to help people manage it all.

The work is fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented, and fully remote. A few things our team members love about working at Jerry:

  • Opportunities to shape the customer experience as the product and services are constantly evolving.

  • Competitive wage and benefits (medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match, paid vacation time).

  • Stock equity (stock options) — we're a tech startup, and you own a piece of what you're building.

  • Flexible scheduling: a 5-day, 8-hour or a 4-day, 10-hour work week.

  • Fully remote, with work equipment provided.

  • A career path in one of the largest industries in the world — insurance. We pay for your P&C insurance license if you don’t have one yet.

  • And, importantly, the colleagues you work alongside. Ask our team what they value most and the answer is almost always the same: the people and the culture. Jerry is full of people who take their work seriously and take helping each other just as seriously.

This role runs on two paths (sales and service). You don't have to know yet whether you're a sales person or a service person. We will figure this out together through the interview process.

As a member in the Customer Operations team, some of your responsibilities could include:

  • Taking great care of our customers. Our team members don't just answer the question asked — they catch the thing the customer didn't know to ask about. A coverage gap. A discount they qualify for. A renewal about to spike.

  • Answering inbound calls from customers shopping auto, home, motorcycle, and other policies, and from policyholders who need something changed.

  • Getting deep on the product. With a large panel of insurance companies to work from, knowing which one fits which customer is the craft of this job. Our app evolves constantly too, and knowing it inside out makes you the person customers trust to navigate it.

  • Problem solving to remove barriers between a customer and the right coverage.

  • Processing service requests — vehicles, drivers, lienholders, policy documents.

  • Making the product better. Tell us what you're hearing. The feedback loop here is short enough that you'll see your suggestions ship.

Who you are:

  • Prior work experience in customer service, sales, or hospitality is a plus, but not required

  • Genuinely friendly and positive attitude and willingness to work as a team

  • Strong work ethic

  • Strong problem solving skills

  • Strong communication skills

Compensation and perks:

  • For sales path: Hourly wage of $19.00 - 21.00 plus uncapped commissions *Our most successful team members typically earn $100,000+ per year.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

We’re fully remote with offices in Palo Alto, New York, Chicago, and Toronto.

Lead People. Drive Performance. Shape Customer Outcomes.

Are you an inspiring operational leader who thrives on developing high-performing teams, improving customer experiences and delivering outstanding business results?
We're looking for an experienced Operations Manager to lead our FAST and Desk Adjusting functions, overseeing a talented team responsible for delivering exceptional claims service to customers and clients. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who combines strong leadership capability with commercial awareness, operational expertise and a passion for continuous improvement.
As a key member of the leadership team, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping performance, embedding best practice and driving strategic initiatives that support growth, efficiency and service excellence.

What will your day look like:


As Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for creating an environment where people, performance and customer outcomes thrive.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, inspire and develop the FAST and Desk Adjusting teams, fostering a positive, high-performance culture.
  • Coach and support Team Managers and senior colleagues, helping them reach their full potential and build future leadership capability.

Governance & Risk Management

Stakeholder & Client Management

raw.description:
Orlando Informer is a theme-park vacation-planning company founded in 2011. Every year, we help millions of people plan a better vacation to Orlando’s biggest destinations with trusted guides, insider tips, savings, and advice. In addition to providing discounted theme park tickets and hotel bookings, we host the Orlando Informer Meetup, exclusive after-hours events featuring shorter waits, unlimited food, and unique entertainment.

We are seeking a contract video editor to produce and edit YouTube videos in a clearly defined, established style. This role is execution focused. You will take the provided footage, scripts, and references and turn them into polished, engaging videos that closely match an existing YouTube content creator in pacing, tone, structure, and visual language.

The ideal candidate has strong technical editing skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to replicate a style. You should be comfortable working from detailed notes, references, and feedback, and delivering consistent results on deadline.

Orlando Informer is a small, nimble, and remote-first company, and this contract role will work closely with our internal team to support ongoing video production needs.

Responsibilities

  • Edit long-form and short-form YouTube videos to match a specific, established Orlando Informer creator's style
  • Replicate pacing, music usage, graphics, sound design, and overall storytelling approach based on provided examples
  • Assemble raw footage, screen recordings, voiceover, music, and graphics into finished videos
  • Add text overlays, basic motion graphics, b-roll, sound effects, and visual polish where appropriate
  • Ensure videos meet platform best practices for YouTube, including pacing, clarity, and viewer retention
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions efficiently and accurately
  • Organize project files and exports according to internal standards
  • Meet agreed-upon deadlines and production schedules
  • Other video-related duties

Requirements

  • This is a remote, contract position
  • Proven experience editing YouTube videos, with samples that demonstrate consistency and strong storytelling
  • Ability to closely match an existing editing style and follow detailed creative direction
  • Strong proficiency with professional editing software such as Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve
  • Comfort working with shared assets, brand guidelines, and reference videos
  • Excellent attention to detail, including timing, audio levels, text accuracy, and visual consistency
  • Strong communication skills and responsiveness in a remote work environment
  • Interest in or familiarity with theme parks, travel, or YouTube content is required

Benefits

Compensation: $250/per long-form video

At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Executive Vice President, Media Operations

Real Chemistry Media is seeking a strategic and commercially minded EVP, Media Operations to help shape the future growth, performance, and scalability of our media business. This leader will serve as a key partner to executive leadership, driving operational excellence, business performance, organizational scalability, and commercial growth initiatives across the organization.

Operating at the intersection of strategy, operations, finance, talent, and client delivery, this individual will ensure the business is structured to support sustainable growth, maximize profitability, and deliver exceptional client outcomes. The ideal candidate is a builder, problem-solver, and collaborative leader who thrives in fast-paced, matrixed environments and is energized by transforming strategy into action.

Location: This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Media leadership to define and execute business strategies that drive growth, profitability, operational excellence, and market differentiation.
  • Serve as the accountable owner of Media operations end to end, with full responsibility for the operating model, delivery infrastructure, and day-to-day performance of the group.
  • Lead operational integration, process harmonization, and change management efforts across acquired and legacy organizations to create a unified, scalable Media operating model.
  • Own operational governance, capacity and resource planning, and organizational planning to ensure the business scales effectively and sustainably, partnering with Client Finance to translate operational plans into financial outcomes.
  • Design and optimize business processes, governance frameworks, operating models, and decision-making structures that improve efficiency, accountability, scalability, and organizational alignment.
  • Enable business growth through commercial operations, pricing and scoping rigor in collaboration with Client Finance, operational readiness, and scalable business development processes.
  • Partner across Media, Analytics, Medical, Creative, Technology, and Integrated Communications teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery of integrated client solutions.
  • Drive adoption of AI, automation, data, and emerging technologies that enhance productivity, decision-making, and business performance.
  • Develop operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting frameworks that provide leadership with actionable insights on delivery performance, capacity, utilization, and growth.
  • Build a high-performing culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

This Position Is the Perfect Fit For You If

  • You are energized by building and scaling high-performing businesses.
  • You excel at translating growth strategies into operational plans and measurable results.
  • You thrive in complex, matrixed organizations and bring teams together around shared goals.
  • You embrace AI, data, and innovation as catalysts for business performance and transformation.
  • You embody Real Chemistry's values of Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I."

What You Should Have

  • 15+ years of leadership experience in healthcare media, healthcare marketing, agency operations, business strategy, consulting, or related industries.
  • Proven success leading business operations, organizational scaling, process transformation, governance, operational integration, and commercial growth initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare media, omnichannel engagement, analytics, and the evolving healthcare marketing landscape.
  • Experience driving revenue growth, profitability, forecasting, resource management, and operational performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence executive stakeholders in highly matrixed environments.
  • Strong financial acumen, including revenue forecasting, margin optimization, staffing models, and business planning.
  • Experience leveraging AI, automation, and data-driven decision making to improve efficiency and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and change management skills.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

Pay Range: $245,000-$320,000

Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. raw.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

The Vice President of Customer Success for the Strategic Segment is a senior leadership position responsible for overseeing the success of our largest customers, who represent hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue and include some of the world's most recognizable brands. The VP will lead a team of Technical Account Managers and Customer Success professionals, driving outstanding business outcomes and strengthening long-term relationships.

This role requires a proven leader who can balance strategic oversight with operational excellence, leveraging cross-functional collaboration to deliver exceptional value. The ideal candidate will excel in building high-performance teams, fostering innovation, and maintaining alignment with organizational goals.

How will you make an impact?

  • Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the vision for customer success within the Strategic Segment, ensuring alignment with company-wide objectives and business priorities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Services, Product, and R&D teams to deliver on customer outcomes and drive innovation.
  • Team Development: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing, customer-focused team. Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and engagement.
  • Customer Success Metrics: Maintain and improve key performance indicators, including:
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS)
  • Transactional Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Customer Retention
  • Referenceability
  • Account P&L
  • Achievement of customer business objectives
  • Customer health scores

raw.excerpt: WHO WE AREBreakaway is a fast-growing music and entertainment company creating high-energy live experiences and culture-forward brands.
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Breakaway is a fast-growing music and entertainment company creating high-energy live experiences and culture-forward brands. As the largest independent touring music festival in North America, Breakaway brings fans, artists, and communities together across multiple markets through festivals, partnerships, content, and merchandise. Our merchandise extends the Breakaway experience beyond the festival grounds, turning memorable moments, local energy, and music culture into products fans are excited to wear and collect.

THE ROLE

Breakaway is seeking an Apparel Graphics Designer for a contract opportunity. This role will shape the graphic identity of our apparel line, from festival merchandise to limited-edition drops, artist collaborations, and brand partnerships. This individual will partner closely with Merchandising, Marketing, and external production partners to translate brand storytelling into bold, wearable graphics across tees, fleece, outerwear, headwear, and accessories.

The ideal candidate lives at the intersection of music, streetwear, art, and culture and can move fluidly between research, hand-sketched concepts, digital design, garment visualization, and production-ready execution. This person combines a distinct creative point of view with strong technical skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Requirements

RESPONSIBILITIES

Apparel Graphics & Product Storytelling

  • Partner with Merchandising to translate creative briefs, moodboards, assortment plans, and product direction into compelling apparel graphics.
  • Design original graphics, prints, patterns, typography, illustrations, iconography, lockups, and branding applications across seasonal collections, festival merchandise, collaborations, and limited-edition releases.
  • Create culturally relevant, collectible, and distinctly Breakaway designs that are both original and commercially viable.
  • Refine artwork based on creative direction and feedback throughout the design process.

Design & Product Development

  • Develop realistic product mockups that accurately communicate garment construction, artwork placement, scale, materials, colors, and trim details.
  • Develop production-ready artwork and technical packages for both graphic and cut-and-sew products, including garment specifications, measurements, construction details, artwork placement, color callouts, materials, and trims.
  • Partner with printers, embroidery partners, and manufacturers to ensure designs translate successfully across garments, materials, and production methods.
  • Review samples, strike-offs, lab dips, and production proofs; provide clear design feedback and refinements to maintain creative intent and production quality.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner cross-functionally with Merchandising, Product Development, Marketing, Partnerships, and external partners to align creative work with product strategy, brand direction, budgets, and go-to-market timelines.
  • Present concepts and design rationale clearly, incorporating feedback from creative leadership, internal stakeholders, artists, brand partners, and licensors into final designs.

Creative Operations & Trend Awareness

  • Manage multiple projects concurrently against overlapping seasonal, production, and launch deadlines.
  • Stay immersed in music, streetwear, fashion, art, youth culture, and emerging design technology to keep Breakaway's apparel culturally relevant and forward-looking.
  • Contribute ideas that strengthen Breakaway's apparel collections and visual identity.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Fashion Design, Apparel Design, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant graphic or apparel design experience, ideally within fashion, streetwear, sportswear, music, entertainment, or other culture-led brands.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Strong creative point of view and understanding of typography, color, composition, fashion, culture, and emerging design trends.
  • Strong understanding of apparel production and garment development, including print and embroidery techniques, materials, trims, garment construction, cut-and-sew specifications, and factory-ready tech packs.
  • Strong communication, organization, and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities against tight deadlines.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience designing merchandise for music festivals, artists, entertainment, sports, or other culture-led brands.
  • Experience working directly with domestic and overseas manufacturing partners through technical development, sampling, and approvals.
  • Experience with specialty print treatments, washes, appliqués, embroidery, woven labels, trims, and elevated apparel details.
  • Experience supporting limited-edition drops, artist collaborations, licensed products, or brand partnerships.

PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT

To be considered, candidates must submit a creative design portfolio. Please provide a website link or attach a PDF with your application. Please include examples of production-ready artwork, apparel collections, and projects that demonstrate your creative process from concept through final product

Benefits

***Location & Remote Work

This contractor position is 100% remote, and contractors may work remotely regardless of location. Please note that should the opportunity transition to a full-time employee (FTE) position, employees are required to be based in one of our designated home office locations. (New York, Los Angeles, Columbus, Nashville, Charlotte).

Summary

Estamos buscando un Técnico Diesel capacitado y con experiencia para unirse a nuestro equipo, especializado en la reparación y mantenimiento de autobuses comerciales. Además, el técnico brindará soporte a los clientes tanto en persona como a través de consultas remotas o virtuales, asesorando sobre reparaciones o mantenimiento necesarios, garantizando que el equipo funcione según las especificaciones del fabricante y manteniendo documentación detallada de los servicios realizados para respaldar interacciones tanto en el taller como virtuales. La compensación varía entre $52,000 y $93,600 por año, según la experiencia y la disponibilidad.

Job Specifics

  • Diagnosticar y reparar problemas mecánicos en autobuses comerciales, asegurando que todos los sistemas funcionen correctamente.
  • Realizar reconstrucciones de motores, mantenimiento rutinario e inspecciones para garantizar el rendimiento óptimo de los autobuses.
  • Trabajar con sistemas hidráulicos, neumáticos y eléctricos, así como realizar reparaciones de frenos y otros problemas relacionados con sistemas.
  • Llevar a cabo tareas de mantenimiento preventivo para garantizar que los autobuses estén listos para una operación segura y confiable.
  • Probar el rendimiento de los autobuses e identificar áreas que requieran reparaciones o reemplazos.
  • Seguir todos los protocolos de seguridad y directrices regulatorias durante la realización de reparaciones.
  • Mantener registros de servicio precisos y documentación del trabajo realizado.
  • Garantizar que todas las tareas de reparación y mantenimiento se completen de manera oportuna y eficiente.

Qualifications and Experience


Qualifications

  • Diploma de escuela secundaria o equivalente (GED).
  • Mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en reparación y mantenimiento de motores diesel, específicamente en autobuses comerciales.
  • Sólidos conocimientos de motores diesel, sistemas hidráulicos, neumáticos y eléctricos.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y eficiente con mínima supervisión.
  • Gran atención a los detalles y compromiso con los estándares de seguridad.

Experience

  • Certificación ASE en mecánica diesel o un campo relacionado.
  • Licencia de Conducir Comercial (CDL).
  • Más de 5 años de experiencia en reparación de motores diesel, incluyendo experiencia con sistemas de autobuses comerciales.
  • Fuertes habilidades de diagnóstico y capacidad para solucionar y resolver problemas mecánicos complejos.
  • Experiencia en gestión de flotas y trabajo con una variedad de autobuses comerciales.

With flexible schedules and the ability to work remotely, you'll enjoy greater freedom and autonomy in your career. Plus, our commitment to inclusivity ensures that every team member is valued and supported. At our organization, we're on a mission to revolutionize the opportunities available in the mechanic industry by pioneering remote mechanic jobs. We believe that skilled mechanics shouldn't be limited by traditional brick-and-mortar settings but should have the flexibility to work remotely, leveraging technology to provide expert services wherever they're needed.
